messages.content: According to the fragment, what is the informal definition of a process?
The definition of a process, informally, is quite simple: it is a running program.
What does the fragment say about the program itself before the operating system acts on it?
The program itself is a lifeless thing: it just sits there on the disk, a bunch of instructions (and maybe some static data), waiting to spring into action.
What pair of system calls does UNIX present for creating a new process, according to the provided text?
UNIX presents one of the most intriguing ways to create a new process with a pair of system calls: fork() and exec().
What is the purpose of the wait() routine as described in the text?
A third routine, wait(), can be used by a process wishing to wait for a process it has created to complete.
What are the two key benefits of the approach described in RFC 8533?

According to RFC 8533, the two key benefits of this approach are: First, it leads to uniformity between OAM protocols. Second, it supports both nested OAM workflows (i.e., performing OAM functions at different or the same levels through a unified interface) as well as interactive OAM workflows (i.e., performing OAM functions at the same levels through a unified interface).
What is the status of the document RFC 8533 as described in the fragment?

The status of this memo is that it is an Internet Standards Track document. This document is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). It represents the consensus of the IETF community. It has received public review and has been approved for publication by the Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG).
歌剧《费德里奥》的剧情地点和时间分别是什么？
劇情地点：西班牙国家监狱，离塞维利亚几里远；劇情时间：18世纪。
根据资料片段，安全导航运算符的主要优点是什么？
根据片段，安全导航运算符的主要优点是避免了诅咒金字塔现象。不必写多层嵌套if语句，编程者可以写正常的链式表达式。
在C# 6.0及更新版本中，安全导航运算符被称为什么？它支持哪些类似的运算符？
在C# 6.0及更新版本中，安全导航运算符被称为空值条件成员访问运算符（null-conditional member access operator），类似地还有??（空值结合运算符）与?[]（空值条件元素访问运算符）。
What is the main problem with base and bounds that leads to the need for segmentation?
Memory is wasteful. It also makes it quite hard to run a program when the entire address space doesn’t fit into memory; thus, base and bounds is not as flexible as we would like.
According to the fragment, what is the challenge (crux) that segmentation aims to address?
The crux is: HOW TO SUPPORT A LARGE ADDRESS SPACE, specifically, how do we support a large address space with (potentially) a lot of free space between the stack and the heap?
According to the professor, what is one of the fun parts of a professor's job, and why is it important?
According to the professor, the little control they do get to exercise is one of the fun parts of the job. Deciding on assignments is important, and it is not something any professor takes lightly.
What additional tutorial does the professor mention for students interested in the systems programming part?
The professor mentions that if you’re interested in the systems programming part, there is also a little tutorial about the UNIX and C programming environment.
What does this document (RFC 9568) define, and which previous RFC does it obsolete?
This document defines version 3 of the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP) for IPv4 and IPv6. It obsoletes RFC 5798, which previously specified VRRP (version 3).
According to the abstract, what is the role of the VRRP Router that controls the IPv4 or IPv6 address?

The VRRP Router controlling the IPv4 or IPv6 address(es) is associated with a Virtual Router, and the protocol is responsible for dynamically assigning responsibility for that Virtual Router to one of the VRRP Routers on a LAN.
ZIM 文件格式的主要用途是什么？它主要用于哪些项目？
ZIM 文件格式是一种自由档案格式，用于存储 Wiki 内容，以便离线浏览。它主要用于维基百科和其它维基百科项目。
根据片段，ZIM 文件格式相对于原始的 Wikipedia XML 数据库下载有什么优势？
和原始的 Wikipedia XML 维基百科:数据库下载 不同，整个文件可以容易的索引，并且可以被类似Kiwix的程序读取。
What happens to the chasers when the player captures the 'red king' that appears on the screen?
Capture him and you will momentarily immobilize the chasers.
What condition must be met for the pattern to clear and a new challenge to be presented?
If the player is successful in changing all of the balls in the center to red, the pattern clears and then a new challenge is presented.
What is the purpose of the document described in this fragment?

This document describes the high-level requirements for a description and exchange format for Computer Security Incident Response Teams (including alert, incident in investigation, archiving, statistics, reporting, etc.), including the reasons for those requirements.
How are the key words like 'MUST', 'SHALL', and 'MAY' interpreted in this document?
The key words 'MUST', 'MUST NOT', 'REQUIRED', 'SHALL', 'SHALL NOT', 'SHOULD', 'SHOULD NOT', 'RECOMMENDED', 'MAY', and 'OPTIONAL' in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119 [1].
What are the two operations associated with a condition variable, and when is each executed?

The wait() call is executed when a thread wishes to put itself to sleep; the signal() call is executed when a thread has changed something in the program and thus wants to wake up a sleeping thread waiting on this condition variable.
In the provided code example, what does the thr_exit() function do inside the child thread before unlocking the mutex?
In thr_exit(), the child thread sets done to 1, then calls Pthread_cond_signal(&c) to wake up a waiting parent thread, and finally unlocks the mutex with Pthread_mutex_unlock(&m).
根据资料，学习自动机在每一个时间点t=0,1,2,3,...会依次进行哪些操作？
在每一个时间点t=0,1,2,3,...，自動機會從環境讀取輸入，用A來將p(t)更新為p(t+1)，根據機率分布p(t+1)選擇後續狀態，並輸出其動作，而環境會讀取其動作，其結果就是下一個時間的環境輸入。
资料中提到的P-模型、Q-模型和S-模型分别对输入集合x有何不同规定？
常常會選用輸入集合x = { 0,1 }，其中的0和1對應環境「不懲罰」及「懲罰」的反應，這種自動機和環境之間的回授迴路稱為P-模型。而Q-模型允許x是有限集合中的任意值，S-模型是允許x為區間 [0,1]中的实数。
根据资料，在SMTP的EHLO声明中请求一个有效的FQDN通常能阻止多少比例的垃圾邮件进入？
根据资料，“在许多情况下，在SMTP的EHLO声明中简单地请求一个有效的FQDN就足以阻止25%的垃圾邮件进入。”
资料中提到的“地址整理”方法中，用户改变地址后，如果该地址不是用户的有效地址，需要满足什么条件？
根据资料，“如果这不是用户的有效地址，那么它一定要是真的无效的，否则一些人或服务器还是可以向其发送垃圾邮件。”
What is one example of a system call that students learn about in the Lab Projects Xv6, according to the given text?
A system call to count how many system calls have taken place (one counter per system call), or other information-gathering calls.
What does the text say students learn about schedulers and context switching in the section on Processes and Scheduling?
Students learn how schedulers actually work, as well as how a context switch takes place.
Boehm-Demers-Weiser garbage collector（Boehm GC）是一种什么类型的垃圾回收器？它主要应用于哪些编程语言？
Boehm-Demers-Weiser garbage collector，也就是著名的Boehm GC，是計算機應用在C/C++語言上的一個保守的垃圾回收器，可應用於許多經由C/C++開發的專案。
在Boehm GC的示例中，如何将传统的malloc和free调用替换为GC调用？
垃圾收集器作用於未變性的（unmodified）C程式，只要簡單的將malloc呼叫用GC_malloc取代，將realloc取代為GC_realloc呼叫，如此一來便不需要使用到free的函式。
According to the fragment, what are the two specific security challenges mentioned when connecting to a remote site?

According to the fragment, when connecting to a remote site, having some assurance that the remote party is who they say they are becomes a central problem, and ensuring that third parties cannot monitor or alter an on-going communication between two others is also a challenge.
What is identified as the most basic aspect that is new in a distributed system, and what primitives does the fragment say we start with?

The fragment says that the most basic aspect that is new in a distributed system is communication. It then states that we start with the most basic primitives available, messages, and build a few higher-level primitives on top of them.
根据资料片段，某个序列的子序列是如何定义的？
根据片段，在数学中，某个序列的子序列是从最初序列通过去除某些元素但不破坏余下元素的相对位置（在前或在后）而形成的新序列。
What are the two main types of applications where event-based concurrency is often used, according to the text?
According to the text, event-based concurrency is often used in both GUI-based applications as well as some types of internet servers.
What is the two-fold problem that event-based concurrency addresses, as described in the passage?

The problem that event-based concurrency addresses is two-fold. The first is that managing concurrency correctly in multi-threaded applications is difficult, and the second is that threads are not the only way to build concurrent applications—event-based concurrency provides an alternative style.
According to the fragment, what was a common and expensive operation caused by the original file system's layout?
The data blocks of a file were often very far away from its inode, thus inducing an expensive seek whenever one first read the inode and then the data blocks of a file (a pretty common operation).
What problem resulted from the free space not being carefully managed, as described in the fragment?

The file system would end up getting quite fragmented, as the free space was not carefully managed. The free list would end up pointing to a bunch of blocks spread across the disk, and as files got allocated, they would simply take the next free block.
XMF（Extensible Music Format）是一种什么类型的文件格式？
XMF（Extensible Music Format）可扩展音乐格式，是一种用于捆绑音乐为向导的树状视频文件格式。
根据资料，MHTML的副檔名有哪些？它與HTML在儲存方式上有何差異？
MHTML的副檔名為.mht（IE）或.mhtml（Chromium）。與HTML差異在於：HTML頁面中的圖形和其他功能可以分開存放，需要原始文件上引用，也可以通過data URI scheme等途徑嵌入其中；MHTML則把網頁及其附件皆儲存為單一檔案。
資料中提到哪些瀏覽器或程式支持MHTML的創建、編輯或讀取？請至少舉出三個例子。
Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Access）能夠創建及編輯MHTML檔案；Linux平台上的程式kmhtConvert可將文件轉換為MHTML格式；Internet Explorer自5.0版支持MHTML格式；Opera自9.0版支持把網頁保存為MHTML文件或讀取MHTML文件。
What does the document define as 'discontinued x86 instructions'?

Instructions that have at some point been present as documented instructions in one or more x86 processors, but where the processor series containing the instructions are discontinued or superseded, with no known plans to reintroduce the instructions.
According to the text, what happened to the MPX instructions?
These instructions were introduced in 6th generation Intel Cor.
Mycroft 的兩個意圖解析器分別是什麼？它們的運作方式有何不同？
Mycroft使用名為Adapt的意圖解析器將自然語言轉換為機讀數據結構。Adapt透過在語音中按順序尋找特定關鍵字來進行意圖分析。他們還有另一個解析器，Padatious。而Padatious則是使用以範例為基礎的推理來確定意圖。
Mycroft 的 Mark I 和 Mark II 硬體專案有哪些主要差異？
其第一個硬體專案為Mark I，主要是針對開發者發行。其較新的硬體專案為Mark II，則是提供給大眾使用，而非僅針對開發者。與Mark I不同的是，Mark II配備了螢幕，能同時利用視覺與聽覺傳遞訊息。
In the given Common Lisp code for Boole's rule, what is the formula used to compute the approximation of the integral?
The formula used is (* (/ (* 2 h) 45) (+ (* 7 (funcall f x1)) (* 32 (funcall f x2)) (* 12 (funcall f x3)) (* 32 (funcall f x4)) (* 7 (funcall f x5)))), where h is (/ (- x5 x1) 4).
According to the text, in what situation might the composite Boole's rule be applied?
The composite Boole's rule might be applied in cases where the integration is permitted to extend over equidistant sections of the interval.
What are the display specifications of the Asus ZenFone 4.5, and how does its rear camera compare to that of the ZenFone 4?

According to the text, the ZenFone 4.5 has a 4.5-inch WVGA (854×480) TFT display. It does have a better rear camera than the ZenFone 4, carrying an 8 MP rear camera, while using the same 0.3 MP front camera as the ZenFone 4 does.
According to RFC 5127, what is the purpose of aggregating Diffserv service classes in the core of a high-capacity network?

In the core of a high-capacity network, service differentiation may still be needed to support applications' utilization of the network. Applications with similar traffic characteristics and performance requirements are mapped into Diffserv service classes based on end-to-end behavior requirements of the applications.
What is the stated status of RFC 5127 according to the 'Status of This Memo' section?
This memo provides information for the Internet community. It does not specify an Internet standard of any kind. Distribution of this memo is unlimited.
OpenWrt韌體專案的最大特點是什麼？其提供的檔案系統和套件管理方案分別是什麼？
OpenWrt韌體專案的最大特點是高度定制性，超過3,000多個可用的軟體套件（僅計使用GPL協定散佈的套件）。其提供一種合併的SquashFS/JFFS2檔案系統以及一套名為「opkg」的軟體套件管理方案。

messages.content: What is the primary purpose of permissions in software, and what types of functions do they typically control?

Permissions are a means of controlling and regulating access to specific system- and device-level functions by software. Typically, types of permissions cover functions that may have privacy implications, such as the ability to access a device's hardware features (including the camera and microphone), and personal data (such as device storage, the contacts list, and the user's present geographical location).
Where are permissions typically declared, and how are certain permissions granted and revoked at runtime?
Permissions are typically declared in an application's manifest, and certain permissions must be specifically granted at runtime by the user—who may revoke the permission at any time.
「歸剛欸」是什麼意思？它源自於哪一年在什麼平台上流傳的影片？
「歸剛欸」是台語中的「整天、成天」，意指一個人整天都在做某件事情，用以斥責那些沒事做、只會亂搞、找麻煩的人。它源自於2021年下半年一支在抖音上流傳的影片。
根據文化部的貼文，三個常被誤用的迷因詞彙及其正確寫法分別是什麼？
根據文化部貼文，「歸剛」應為「規工」，表示整天；「母湯」應為「毋通」，表示不可以；以及「修但幾列」應為「小等一下」，表示稍等一下。
According to the plot summary, what is the player character's initial situation in the game?
The player character is an adventurer who has come to Waterdeep looking for employ from Khelben Blackstaff, high mage of the city.
What does Khelben Blackstaff tell the player about the disappearances and the dungeon, and what does he assign?

Blackstaff informs the player that people have been disappearing mysteriously, and some return from Undermountain with frightening tales. Blackstaff assigns several quests to the player character so he can find out the cause behind the renewed activity from the dungeon.
According to the passage, why are operating systems particularly important from a security perspective?

According to the passage, operating systems are particularly important from a security perspective because pretty much everything runs on them. The passage states that 'operating systems are particularly important from a security perspective. Why? To begin with, pretty much everything runs on them.'
What does the passage say about the likelihood of attacks on computer systems in almost any computing scenario?
The passage says that 'Attacks on computer systems are so common as to be inevitable in almost any scenario where you perform computing.'

根据资料片段，網路電腦的定義是什麼？它與計算機終端有何不同？
網路電腦是指几乎只通过網路的轻量级计算机，它有自己的中央处理器和随机存储记忆体，没有如硬盘等的辅助存储器，通过计算机网络启动，并在本地运行应用程序。它和计算机终端不同，它不是应用程序服务器的一个客户端。
资料片段中提到了哪些關於網路電腦的歷史預言和現狀？
20世纪90年代，Larry Ellison和甲骨文公司预言网路计算机将在不远的将来取代台式机，但时至今日，这个预言尚未实现。正如個人電腦並未取代大型電腦一般，網路電腦也不會取代個人電腦，它只在特定的場合提供了一個更合適的替代方案，也可透過开放式标准與早已建立的系統並存。
惠普車庫位於哪裡，被認為是什麼地方？
惠普車庫位於加利福尼亞州帕羅奧圖，為惠普公司的創業地，被認為是矽谷之發源地。
惠普公司名稱是如何確定的？
1939年，帕卡德和休利特通過擲硬幣結成合作夥伴關係，從而創造了 Hewlett-Packard 的公司名稱。
根据资料，SYSLINUX中的PXELINUX通常使用在什么类型的设备上？它使用哪些网络协议来下载启动程序？
PXELINUX通常使用在與預啟動執行環境相容唯讀記憶體的網路卡上。預啟動執行環境使用DHCP或BOOTP來使用基本的TCP/IP 網路，並透過TFTP下載啟動程式。
资料中提到，从SYSLINUX哪个版本开始，EXTLINUX被合并至SYSLINUX里？另外，从SYSLINUX第五版开始，哪种扩展名的模块不再被支持？
從SYSLINUX 4開始，EXTLINUX被合併至SYSLINUX裡。從SYSLINUX第五版開始，16位元的.com模組不再被支援。
Android Beam在Android 10中被什么功能取代？
Android Beam於Android 10中被移除，以一個名為「鄰近分享」（類似iOS的AirDrop）的功能代替。
根据片段，在Android 4.1 Jelly Bean更新中，Android Beam如何传输相片及视频？
基於Android 4.1 Jelly Bean的更新，裝置可以使用Android Beam來傳輸相片及視頻。Android Beam使用NFC來開啟雙邊裝置的藍牙，同時配對它們，並且在完成傳輸時自動關閉兩裝置的藍牙。這項功能只能在雙邊裝置都在Android版本4.1或以上時適用。
Who developed and published Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing, and in collaboration with whom?
Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing was developed and published by Monster Games in collaboration with sprint car and NASCAR team owner and former driver Tony Stewart.
On which platforms and dates was Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing released, and where can it be purchased?

It was released for the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One on February 14, 2020 and on Microsoft Windows on February 21, 2020. The game can only be purchased at Walmart, because of a deal with Stewart and the corporation.
根据资料片段，网络编码的概念是在哪一年由谁首次提出的？
Rudolf Ahlswede, Ning Cai, Shuo-Yen Robert Li, Raymond W. Yeung在2000年首次提出网络编码的概念。
What is the title of the list and how is it organized?
The title is 'List of Amiga games (P–Z)'. This is a list of games for the Amiga computer, organised alphabetically by name.
According to RFC 1982, what is the stated purpose of this memo regarding the serial number field of the SOA resource record?
The memo supplies the missing definition of 'sequence space arithmetic' for the serial number field of the SOA resource record, and it is intended to update RFC1034 and RFC1035.
What is the primary purpose of the objects defined in RFC 3371?
It defines objects for managing networks using Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol (L2TP).
According to the table of contents, which section discusses the 'Relationship to the Interface MIB' and what subsections does it include?
Section 3.1 discusses the 'Relationship to the Interface MIB', and it includes subsections 3.1.1 Layering Model and 3.1.2 Interface MIB Object.
UTM参数的英文全称是什么？它是由哪个产品引入的？
UTM参数的英文全称是Urchin Tracking Module，缩写为UTM。它是由Google分析的前身Urchin引入的五种用于市场营销的URL参数。
根据片段，UTM参数的作用是什么？它一共有几种？
UTM参数的作用是：通过向网址添加Urchin广告系列参数，分析网站可以区分当前用户从哪种广告进入此网站等。UTM参数共有五种，使用中可以多项组合进行使用。
What are the three academic fields that Cristopher David Moore is known as?
He is an American computer scientist, mathematician, and physicist.
Where did Cristopher Moore complete his undergraduate studies and in what year did he graduate?
He did his undergraduate studies at Northwestern University, graduating in 1986.
What error-related techniques does AMTOR incorporate to improve on RTTY, and how does it perform in poor and noisy HF conditions?
AMTOR improves on RTTY by incorporating error detection or error correction techniques. The protocol remains relatively uncomplicated and AMTOR performs well even in poor and noisy HF conditions.
In what two modes does AMTOR operate, and what is the bit structure of each character in its protocol?

AMTOR operates in one of two modes: an error detection mode and an automatic repeat request (ARQ) mode. The AMTOR protocol utilizes a 7-bit code for each character, with each code-word having four mark and three space bits.
How does the combat in Hell Yeah! Wrath of the Dead Rabbit work, and what are the two ways monsters can be killed?

The combat uses twin-stick shooter controls, in which movement is controlled by one thumbstick or set of keys, and firing weapons is controlled by the other thumbstick or another set of keys. The player fights the monsters using a variety of projectile weapons, and can purchase additional weapons. Monsters can also be killed by cutting into the [fragment ends mid-sentence, but the stated ways are projectile weapons and cutting into the monster].

meta.title: Hell Yeah! Wrath of the Dead Rabbit

messages.content: In the scenario described in RFC 36, what does process PA in host A do to initiate a connection, and what system call is mentioned?
Process PA in host A grabs socket SA and requests connection with socket SB. Process PA accomplishes this through a system call.
According to the table of contents, which chapter introduces the topic 'Virtualizing The CPU' and on which page does that subsection begin?
Chapter 2, 'Introduction to Operating Systems', introduces the topic 'Virtualizing The CPU' in subsection 2.1, which begins on page 5.
According to RFC 7793, what does RFC 6598 specify regarding reverse DNS queries for Shared Address Space addresses?
RFC 6598 specifies that "Reverse DNS queries for Shared Address Space addresses [100.64.0.0/10] MUST NOT be forwarded to the global DNS infrastructure."
What action does RFC 7793 formally direct IANA to take, and for what purpose?
This document formally directs IANA to add the associated zones to the "IPv4 Locally-Served DNS Zones Registry" to prevent such queries from accidentally leaking to the global DNS infrastructure.
What is the primary purpose of RFC 6734 as stated in the abstract?

Some Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) applications require the transport of cryptographic keying material. This document specifies a set of Attribute-Value Pairs (AVPs) providing native Diameter support of cryptographic key delivery.
According to the 'Status of This Memo' section, what type of document is RFC 6734 and who does it represent?
This is an Internet Standards Track document. This document is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). It represents the consensus of the IETF community.
Besides introducing the semaphore, what other contributions of Edsger Dijkstra are mentioned in the fragment?

Besides introducing the semaphore, the fragment mentions his famous 'shortest paths' algorithm in graph theory, and an early polemic on structured programming entitled 'Goto Statements Considered Harmful'.
According to the fragment, what is the second type of memory called, and how are allocations and deallocations handled in it?
The second type of memory is called heap memory, where all allocations and deallocations are explicitly handled by you, the programmer.
在2021年1月的争论事件中，愤怒的香蕉发表了怎样的言论？最终该女作者采取了什么行动？
愤怒的香蕉发表了四十多条微博指责该事件下扩大化的行为，指责女作者‘控诉者不说名字’，是‘所谓的坏女权’、‘恰女权饭’。最终，在网络文学圈压力下，该女作者捐款3万元，并向网友道歉，凭此证明自己不是‘为流量炒作’。
According to the passage, why does the operating system need to be careful when providing services that have security implications?

The operating system needs to be careful in such cases to do the right thing, security-wise, because operating systems provide services for processes, and some of those services have security implications.
What does the passage state about the circumstances under which operating system services should be performed?
The passage states that any service that the operating system might be able to perform probably should be performed – under the right circumstances, and that context will be everything.
根据资料，基于签名的防键盘记录器最大的弊端是什么？
基于签名的防键盘记录器最大的弊端是只能保护用户不受特征库中的键盘记录器影响，故仍对未知或未识别的键盘记录器无防御。网络罪犯可以下载著名的键盘记录器之一，进行足够程度的修改，防键盘记录器即无法识别。
根据资料，启发式分析类防键盘记录器的工作原理及其一个弊端是什么？
启发式分析类软件不使用签名数据库，而利用一系列已知由键盘记录器使用的特征、属性和方法进行检测。它分析计算机内全部模块的执行方式，由此阻止任何类似键盘记录器工作方式模块的活动。其弊端之一是这类软件也会阻止非键盘记录器，一些无害的软件模块，包括系统或合法软件的组件，也会使用键盘记录器使用的进程，故可能触发误报。
“牧師”的本名、軍種、兵種和階級分別是什麼？他在菲律賓行動中與誰共同作出什麼決定？
“牧師”的本名是托馬斯·沃克（Thomas Walker），是美國海軍特種作戰開發組步槍兵，階級為士官長（E-7）。在菲律賓的行動中為了拯救人質而與“老媽”共同作出擅自作主的決定，導致兩人被停職。
“老媽”在杜拜行動期間遭遇了什麼事件？其最終的結局是什麼？
“老媽”與“牧師”在杜拜行動期間一同被薩拉丁的手下綁架，後在動盪之夜中因拒絕向薩拉丁供出情報而遭其槍決死亡。
Color TV-Game 系列共包含哪几种不同的主机？该系列的总销量大约是多少？
系列有五种不同的主机，都仅在日本开发并发行。總計銷量約250至300萬。
What is a primary difficulty that arises with the arrival of more than a single CPU, according to the text?
A primary one is that a typical application (i.e., some C program you wrote) only uses a single CPU; adding more CPUs does not make that single application run faster.
How can multi-threaded applications benefit from multiple CPUs, as stated in the text?
Multi-threaded applications can spread work across multiple CPUs and thus run faster when given more.
HTML5 Shiv是由谁创造的？它主要解决Internet Explorer哪个版本之前的什么问题？
HTML5 Shiv是由Sjoerd Visscher所创造的JavaScript的一种备选方案。它允许Internet Explorer 9之前的版本识别HTML5标记，并允许他们使用CSS样式。
According to the fragment, what is Florida's specific view of knowledge work?

Florida's view of it as specifically, "the direct manipulation of symbols to create an original knowledge product, or to add obvious value to an existing one," which limits the definition of knowledge work to mainly creative work.
What is the purpose of the new Information Elements (IEs) introduced in RFC 8549?

By introducing new Information Elements (IEs), this document extends the existing BGP-related IEs to enable IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) to export BGP community information, including the BGP Standard Communities defined in RFC 1997, BGP Extended Communities defined in RFC 4360, and BGP Large Communities defined in RFC 8092.
According to RFC 8549, what can be accumulated based on the network operator's BGP community planning?
According to the network operator's BGP community planning, network traffic information can then be accumulated.
What is contrast in visual perception, and what are two types of contrast mentioned in the text?

According to the text, contrast in visual perception is a felt difference in appearance of two or more parts of a field seen simultaneously or successively (hence: brightness contrast, lightness contrast, color contrast, simultaneous contrast, successive contrast, etc.). Two types of contrast mentioned are brightness contrast and lightness contrast (or alternatively, simultaneous contrast and successive contrast).
How is contrast defined in physics, and what are two example formulae given for it?

In physics, contrast is a quantity intended to correlate with the perceived brightness contrast, usually defined by one of a number of formulae which involve e.g. the luminances of the stimuli considered. Two example formulae given are: ΔL/L near the luminance threshold (known as Weber contrast), and LH/LL for much higher luminances. Additionally, a contrast can also be due to differences of chromaticity specified by colorimetric characteristics.
According to the cited webpage from barrypopik.com, who originally said the quote that later became attached to Confucius?

Confucian philosopher Xunzi said “Not having heard something is not as good as having heard it; having heard it is not as good as having seen it; having seen it is not as good as knowing it; knowing it is not as good as putting it into practice.”
What is the title and date of the webpage cited in the fragment, and who is thanked for providing the information about the quote?
The webpage is entitled “Tell me and I forget; teach me and I may remember; involve me and I will learn” and is dated December 19, 2012. Thanks to Jiao Dong (Rutgers) for telling us!
Apple Newton 是由哪家公司于哪一年开始制造，并于哪一年停止生产？
根據片段，Apple Newton 由蘋果電腦公司于1993年开始制造，並於1997年停止了生產。
Newton 的作業系統名稱是什麼？蘋果公司對其的正式名稱是什麼？
根據片段，Newton 使用的作業系統是Newton OS，而蘋果公司對其的正式名稱為"MessagePad"，"Newton"則是蘋果公司對其所使用之作業系統的稱呼（Newton OS）。
According to the fragment, what is the one very simple thing that a running program does?
A running program does one very simple thing: it executes instructions.
What does the fragment suggest a reader should do if they do not already have some idea of what a computer program does when it runs?

If not, this book (and the corresponding course) is going to be difficult — so you should probably stop reading this book, or run to the nearest bookstore and quickly consume the necessary background material before continuing (both Patt & Patel [PP03] and Bryant & O’Hallaron [BOH10] are pretty great books).
According to the passage, what does the free list structure contain, and what assumption is made about the primary concern of allocators?

This structure contains references to all of the free chunks of space in the managed region of memory. We further assume that primarily we are concerned with external fragmentation, as described above.
In the code example provided in Figure 30.1, what does the child function print, and what comment indicates the need to signal completion?

In the code example provided in Figure 30.1, the child function prints "child" (via printf("child\n")), and the comment "// XXX how to indicate we are done?" indicates the need to signal completion before returning NULL.
Who developed SINoALICE and for which platforms was it developed?
SINoALICE is a role-playing video game developed by Pokelabo for Android and iOS.
What is the setting and main goal of the characters in the plot of SINoALICE?

The plot is set in a world called Library filled with countless stories, where the Characters within each story wish to revive their author for their desired future. To do so, they work together to gather inochi and fight the Nightmares that devour stories, knowing they will inevitably have to kill each other to get their wish.
资料中提到DHCP的历史发展及其对应的RFC定义分别是什么？
资料指出，DHCP于1993年10月成为标准协议，其前身是BOOTP协议。当前的DHCP定义可以在RFC 2131中找到，而基于IPv6的DHCPv6可以在RFC 3315中找到。
根据片段内容，RFC 2993 的标题是什么？
RFC 2993 的标题是 "Architectural Implications of NAT"。
片段中提到了哪些与NAT穿透相关的具体技术？
片段中提到的与NAT穿透相关的具体技术包括：Session Traversal Utilities for NAT（STUN）、Traversal Using Relay NAT（TURN）、NAT-T（Negotiation of NAT-Traversal in the IKE）以及Teredo tunnel。
本作《荣誉勋章：空降神兵》是由哪家公司开发，属于什么题材和类型的游戏？
本作是一款由EALA开发的二战题材第一人称射击游戏，为荣誉勋章系列的第11部正传。
在游戏中，玩家扮演哪支部队的士兵，并参与了哪些主要战役？
遊戲中，玩家將扮演一名服役於美軍第82空降師，名叫Boyd Travers的傘兵，並參與盟軍對西西里，諾曼第和德國本土的反攻。
What does the document RFC 8319 allow for overriding on a per-link basis?

This document allows for overriding these values on a per-link basis, referring to the maximum time between sending unsolicited multicast RAs and the maximum router lifetime, which are otherwise specified by the IPv6 Neighbor Discovery protocol and can also be overridden by link-layer-specific documents.
斯温森-王算法是在哪一年、由谁提出的？它属于哪种类型的蒙特卡洛算法？
斯温森－王算法由物理学家与王建生于1987年提出，是首个非局域的蒙特卡洛算法。
斯温森-王算法最初用于哪些模型？其关键步骤包括哪些？
斯温森－王算法最初用于易辛模型与玻茨模型。其关键步骤是：按照Fortuin与Kasteleyn的理论将玻茨模型变换为渗流理论的模型，相邻自旋间按概率成键；之后通过霍森－科佩尔曼算法标识联键的集团，并将每个集团内的所有自旋赋以相同的随机值。
According to the text, why is the VAX/VMS virtual memory manager considered worth studying?
It is one of the earliest examples of a “modern” virtual memory manager, and a surprising number of techniques and approaches from this system survive to this day, thus it is well worth studying.
What does the text say about ideas that are 50 years old in the context of technology-driven disciplines?

Some ideas, even those that are 50 years old, are still worth knowing, a thought that is well known to those in most other fields (e.g., Physics), but has to be stated in technology-driven disciplines (e.g., Computer Science).
What does the Concurrent Web Server project require students to do with a simple web server?
Students take a simple web server (or build one) and add a thread pool to it, in order to serve requests concurrently.
In the Concurrent Web Server project, what are the requirements for the thread pool and the buffer used to pass requests?
The thread pool should be of a fixed size, and use a producer/consumer bounded buffer to pass requests from a main thread to the fixed pool of workers.
Allkpop是什么类型的网站？它是在何时何地推出的？
Allkpop是韩国流行音乐英文博客，于2007年10月30日在美国推出，总部设在美国新泽西州。
Allkpop的母公司是谁？它每月有多少读者？韩国先驱报如何评价Allkpop？
Allkpop由其母公司6Theory Media拥有和运营，每月有超过750万读者。韩国先驱报称allkpop为“最快的韩国流行音乐新闻发布者”。
What is the term used in operating systems for the space reserved on the disk for moving pages back and forth?
In operating systems, we generally refer to such space as swap space, because we swap pages out of memory to it and swap pages into memory from it.
According to the text, what combination of factors led to the need to support using more memory than is physically available?
The combination of multiprogramming and ease-of-use leads us to want to support using more memory than is physically available.
According to the passage, what does security access fundamentally determine?
According to the passage, security access determines which resources or services can be accessed by which parties in which ways under which circumstances.
What type of decision does the passage say security access boils down to, and what example is given to make the problem more concrete?

The passage says security access boils down to another of those binary decisions that fit so well into our computing paradigms: yes or no. To make the problem more concrete, it considers the case where User X wishes to read and write file /var/foo, which implies that a process being run under the identity of User X issued a system call such as: open("/var/foo", O RDWR).
ISO/IEC 8859-15:1999 的俗称是什么？它是在哪一年制定的？
ISO/IEC 8859-15:1999 又称Latin-9，俗称Latin-0。这个字符集于1998年制定。
根据片段，ISO/IEC 8859-15 字符集在哪些码位范围未作定义？
0x00-0x1F、0x7F、0x80-0x9F在此字符集中未有定义。
Who are the developers and publisher of the game 'Maestro! Jump In Music'?
The game is published by BigBen Interactive and developed by French studios Pastagames and Neko Entertainment.
What is the plot of 'Maestro! Jump In Music' according to the provided text?

In a world filled with music, a songbird named Presto and a spider named Staccato catch the eye of Bella Bellissima, who eventually falls for Presto's soothing voice over Staccato's guitar playing. Heartbroken, Staccato creates a smog that spreads across the world.
When and where did the 10th Annual Shorty Awards take place, and who hosted the ceremony?
The 10th Annual Shorty Awards powered by DirecTV Now took place on April 15, 2018, at the PlayStation Theater, New York City. The ceremony was hosted by actress, singer, songwriter, Keke Palmer.
What were the key dates for nominations, public voting closing, finalists announcement, and winners announcement for the 10th Annual Shorty Awards?
Nominations were announced on January 16, 2018, with public voting closing on February 22, 2018. Finalists were announced on March 20, 2018. Winners were announced at the ceremony on April 15, 2018.
在排程中，延遲時間是用來衡量什麼的？
延遲時間衡量某工作實際完成時間，與應完成時間（交期）相比，延誤多少。
根據片段，在製造業中，延遲與提早各會造成什麼不利影響？
延遲導致工作積壓，並要因誤期違約賠償顧客，損失商譽。相反，提早則會佔用倉庫，提高成本，阻礙資本流動。
At what granularity is network traffic analyzed according to the beginning of this document, and what does this granularity represent?
Network traffic is analyzed at the BGP community granularity, which represents the traffic of different kinds of customers, services, or geographical regions.
According to the 'Status of This Memo' section, what type of document is this, and which organization produced it?
This is an Internet Standards Track document. This document is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).
According to the fragment, what is the key distinction made between blocks and pages in a flash plane, and why is this distinction important?

The fragment states: "We’ll see below why we distinguish between blocks and pages; it turns out this distinction is critical for ﬂash operations such as reading and writing, and even more so for the overall performance of the device."
What is the most important and weird thing to learn about writing to a page within a block in flash memory, as described in the fragment?
The fragment says: "The most important (and weird) thing you will learn is that to write to a page within a block, you ﬁrst have to erase the entire block."
如果某個應用程式沒有指定資料，透過Android Beam傳輸該應用程式時，接收裝置會發生什麼事？
如果該應用程式沒有指定資料，傳輸該應用程式時會在接收裝置打開此應用程式。如果接收裝置沒有此應用程式，則該應用程式在Google Play的頁面會自動打開。
根據資料片段，S Beam與Android Beam的主要差異是什麼？

Instead, the data is provided by the client in buffers. The NETBLT layer transfers each buffer as a sequence of packets, but since each buffer is composed of...
「後個人電腦時代」一詞是由哪家公司提出的？根據片段，它類似於哪家公司描述的什麼概念？
「後個人電腦時代」是蘋果公司提出的詞彙，類似微軟公司描述的PC+。
根據片段，蘋果公司CEO提姆·庫克（Tim Cook）如何描述後PC時代中PC與移動設備的關係？
提姆·庫克（Tim Cook）描述世界的PC將不再有只是一個人的數字生活的中心，移動設備如平板電腦和智慧手機將是「更便攜，更個性化和極大地簡化到任何個人電腦」。
What is the objective of the game Round-Up, as described in the gameplay section?

The object of the game is for the player to maneuver his white robot within a maze, capture a red character robot as they move about the maze, and race to the center to change the 9 white balls located there to red. The player may only change one white ball to red at a time after he has captured a red robot, and must evade 4 chaser monsters in the process.
Who released the game as Fitter, and in which regions and months did this release occur according to the text?

Taito released the game as Fitter, in Japan in October 1981 and in Europe the same year. Additionally, another Japanese company, Hiraoka, licensed a version called Round-Up to Centuri for release in the Americas in December 1981.
What is the primary objective of the Lower-Effort Per-Hop Behavior (LE PHB) as specified in RFC 8622?

The primary objective of this LE PHB is to protect Best-Effort (BE) traffic (packets forwarded with the default PHB) from LE traffic in congestion situations, i.e., when resources become scarce, BE traffic has precedence over LE traffic and may preempt it.
According to the document header of RFC 8622, which RFCs does this document update and which does it obsolete?
RFC 8622 obsoletes RFC 3662 and updates RFC 4594 and RFC 8325. The header states: 'Obsoletes: 3662' and 'Updates: 4594, 8325'.
What is the publication status of RFC 6959 according to the document's first paragraph?
This document is not an Internet Standards Track specification; it is published for informational purposes.
Who approved RFC 6959 for publication, and what is its relationship to Internet Standards?

It has been approved for publication by the Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG). Not all documents approved by the IESG are a candidate for any level of Internet Standard; see Section 2 of RFC 5741.
What is the abbreviated name of the Saxon State and University Library Dresden, and what two institutional traditions does its name represent?

The abbreviated name is SLUB Dresden. The seemingly redundant name is to show that the library brings both these institutional traditions together, namely the Saxon State Library (SLB) and the University Library Dresden (UB).

It was created in 1996 through the merger of the Saxon State Library (SLB) and the University Library Dresden (UB).

messages.content: 根据资料，DOSBox的开发始于哪个操作系统的发布，以及当时两位创始人发现了什么？
DOSBox的开发始于Windows 2000的发布。Windows 2000是一个Windows NT系列的操作系统，当时DOSBox的两位创始人彼得·文斯特拉（荷兰语：Peter Veenstra）和舍尔德·范德伯格（荷兰语：Sjoerd van der Berg）发现Windows 2000已经放弃了对大部分DOS软件的支持。
在DOSBox的“特性”部分中，它如何描述自身的模拟方式，以及它对CPU和操作系统的要求是什么？
DOSBox是一个完整的计算机的模拟，并不只是一个兼容层，如DOSEMU，也不依赖386处理器虚拟化能力的Windows与OS/2 VDM操作系统，不需要x86中央处理器或者任何DOS版本以运行，并且能运行实模式与保护模式的程序。
Thunder Lotus Games 的第二作类银河恶魔城游戏在 Kickstarter 上发起专案后，多久达到了众筹目标？该游戏于何时在哪些平台上发行？
第二作类银河恶魔城游戏《》進展亦也順利，在Kickstarter發起專案後一日内就以達到眾籌目標，於2017年7月在PC和PS4上發行。
Thunder Lotus Games 的第三作模拟经营游戏《靈魂遠去》是如何获得资金支持的？其游戏原型、发行时间、评价和销量情况如何？
第三作模拟经营游戏《靈魂遠去》則沒有發起專案眾籌，而是與投資基金Kowloon Nights簽約合作。遊戲以北歐神話為原型，在2020年8月在多平台發行，所得評價以正面為主，銷量超過100萬份。
According to the passage, what are the two unique properties of flash memory mentioned?

The two unique properties of flash memory are: to write to a given chunk of it (i.e., a flash page), you first have to erase a bigger chunk (i.e., a flash block), which can be quite expensive; and writing too often to a page will cause it to wear out.
What is the central challenge (CRUX) posed in the passage regarding building a flash-based SSD?

The central challenge is: HOW TO BUILD A FLASH-BASED SSD - how can we handle the expensive nature of erasing, and how can we build a device that lasts a long time, given that repeated overwrite will wear the device out?
What happens if the TLB holds the translation for the VPN on a virtual address reference, and what is the next step after determining this?

If the TLB holds the translation for the VPN, we have a TLB hit, which means the TLB holds the translation. Then we can extract the page frame number (PFN) from the relevant TLB entry, concatenate that onto the offset from the original virtual address, and form the desired physical address (PA), and access memory (Lines 5–7), assuming protection checks do not fail (Line 4).
What does the CPU do if it does not find the translation in the TLB (a TLB miss)?

If the CPU does not find the translation in the TLB (a TLB miss), we have some more work to do. In this example, the hardware accesses the page table to find the translation (Lines 11–12), and, assuming that the virtual memory reference gene...
According to RFC 3796, what is the stated purpose of the document, and what type of memo is it classified as?

The document seeks to record all usage of IPv4 addresses in currently deployed IETF Operations & Management Area accepted standards. It is classified as an Informational memo, and the status of this memo states that it provides information for the Internet community and does not specify an Internet standard of any kind.
Who authored RFC 3796, and what is the publication date and category of the document?
The authors are P. Nesser, II (Nesser & Nesser Consulting) and A. Bergstrom, Ed. (Ostfold University College). The document is dated June 2004, and its category is Informational.
What happens to the contents of memory when there is a power loss, according to the fragment?
Unlike memory, whose contents are lost when there is a power loss, a persistent-storage device keeps such data intact.
According to the fragment, what does the OS need to take extra care with, and why?

The OS must take extra care with a persistent-storage device because this is where users keep data that they really care about, and the device stores information permanently (or at least, for a long time).
根据资料，服务器开发的网络层设计主要考虑哪三个方面？
网络层设计主要考虑三个方面，一是连接方式，是使用TCP还是UDP；二是多路利用，选择合适的网络IO机制，如select,epoll等；三是协议解析，协议的消息传递其实与网络层无关，只是数据打包，解包的过程，但通常也归纳在这。
在服务器开发的常用技术中，内存池的设计目的是什么？
内存池的设计是为了循环使用内存资源，可根据不同场景设计不同的内存池模型。
What was the original name of the first version of the AFS system, and why was it redesigned?

The first version (which we will call AFSv1, but actually the original system was called the ITC distributed file system [S+85]) had some of the basic design in place, but didn’t scale as desired, which led to a re-design and the final protocol (which we will call AFSv2, or just AFS) [H+88].
How does the text refer to Carnegie Mellon University, and what reason is given for this form of reference?

The text refers to CMU in its original fully-hyphenated form, 'Carnegie-Mellon University', because 'As AFS derived from work in the early 80’s, we refer to CMU in its original fully-hyphenated form.'
What does the acronym CAST stand for in the context of software testing?
The acronym stands for 'Computer Aided Software Testing'.
Why are CAST tools considered cost-effective and time-saving according to the text?
They are known to be cost-effective and time-saving because they reduce the incidence of human error and are thorough.
根據資料，摩爾莊園的世界觀中，摩爾王三世二十八年黑森林發生了什麼事件？
摩爾王三世二十八年，黑森林突發大火，野火隨著風勢迅速蔓延，不僅毀壞了摩爾們生活的地洞，而且拉姆們賴以維生的大榕樹也被燒成了灰燼。
According to the table of contents, on which page does the subsection 'Shortest Time-to-Completion First (STCF)' begin?
According to the table of contents, the subsection 'Shortest Time-to-Completion First (STCF)' begins on page 76.
According to the MLFQ scheduling rules, if two jobs A and B have equal priority, how are they scheduled?
Rule 2 states: If Priority(A) = Priority(B), A & B run in round-robin (RR) scheduling.
What is the key factor in MLFQ scheduling that determines how the scheduler sets priorities for jobs?
The key to MLFQ scheduling lies in how the scheduler sets priorities. Rather than giving a fixed priority to each job, MLFQ varies the priority of a job based on its observed behavior.
Which companies are listed as partners of DriveNets according to the provided text?
Among its partners are Fujitsu, Broadcom Inc., Itochu Techno-Solutions, Wipro, KGPCo and EPCglobal.
Who founded Night Inc. and in which year?
Night Inc. was founded in 2015 by Reed Duchscher.
What are the different business divisions that Night Inc. has expanded into since its founding?

Since its founding, the company has expanded into venture capital investing (Night Capital), original programming (Night Studios), seed-stage investing (Night Ventures), as well as maintaining its original talent management firm, Night Media.
根据片段，诺谟图的精度取决于什么？
诺谟图的精度取决于查图时的数据点在图上点出、引申的准确程度，直线直的程度。
根据资料片段，X会话管理器的主要功能是什么？
在X Window系统中，X会话管理器是一个会话管理程序，这个程序能够保存和恢复一组程序的当前运行状态。
资料片段中提到，X Window系统默认的会话管理器叫什么名字？KDE默认的会话管理器又是什么？
X Window系统包含了默认的会话管理器，名字叫xsm。特定的桌面系统也开发了自己的会话管理器：例如，ksmserver是KDE默认的会话管理器。
What is the purpose of using LDP Downstream-on-Demand (DoD) label advertisement according to RFC 7032?
The purpose is to reduce the amount of state access devices can hold.
In the context of Seamless MPLS design, what does RFC 7032 describe and list regarding LDP DoD?
This document describes LDP DoD use cases and lists required LDP DoD procedures in the context of Seamless MPLS design.
智慧城市在国际上被广泛认同的定义是什么？
智慧城市是新一代信息技术支撑、知识社会下一代创新（创新2.0）环境下的城市形态，强调智慧城市不仅仅是物联网、云计算等新一代信息技术的应用，更重要的是通过面向知识社会的创新2.0的方法论应用，构建用户创新、开放创新、大众创新、协同创新为特征的城市可持续创新生态。
智慧城市的概念最早源于哪里？
智慧城市的概念最早源于IBM提出的“智慧地球”这一理念，此前类似的概念还有數位城市等。
What is a modulus of convergence in real analysis?

In real analysis, a branch of mathematics, a modulus of convergence is a function that tells how quickly a convergent sequence converges. These moduli are often employed in the study of computable analysis and constructive mathematics.
In the Vm Beyondphys Policy text, what is the definition of PMiss and what is its range of possible values?

According to the text, PMiss is the probability of not finding the data in the cache (a miss). PMiss varies from 0.0 to 1.0, and sometimes we refer to a percent miss rate instead of a probability (e.g., a 10% miss rate means PMiss = 0.10).
浙江政务服务网集哪些部分为一体？
浙江政务服务网集全省统一的政务服务互联网门户、行政权力（行政审批）事项库、行政审批运行系统、政务云基础设施公共平台为一体。
浙江政务服务网的阳光政务板块中列明了哪些清单？
阳光政务板块中列明行政权力清单、企业投资负面清单、财政专项资金管理清单和部门责任清单等。
结构解引用运算符（->）在C语言与C++中具有什么功能？它的优先级和结合性如何？
结构解引用运算符（->）的功能是获取运算符左侧的指针所指向的对象的某个成员。该运算符的优先级较高，与函数调用运算符( )、数组下标运算符[ ]、通过引用选择成员运算符.相同，也是自左向右结合。
C++中规定，当结构解引用运算符（->）的左端不是指针类型时，编译器如何处理？
C++规定，运算符左端如果不是指针类型，编译器则调用该运算符的重载版本。如果没有重载版本则编译报错。该运算符的重载版本的返回值，或者是指针类型，或者是内含重载定义了->运算符的类型；对这两种情形编译器分别做指针解引用与递归调用返回类型的重载版本的->运算符。
What is a condition variable according to the provided text?

A condition variable is an explicit queue that threads can put themselves on when some state of execution (i.e., some condition) is not as desired (by waiting on the condition); some other thread, when it changes said state, can then wake one (or more) of those waiting threads and thus allow them to continue (by signaling on the condition).
According to the text, who originally proposed the idea of 'private semaphores' and who later named it a 'condition variable'?
The idea goes back to Dijkstra’s use of “private semaphores” [D68]; a similar idea was later named a “condition variable” by Hoare in his work on monitors [H74].
Besides operating its own website, what other services did BeatThatQuote.com provide?
BeatThatQuote.com also provided the services for other comparison websites such as ArgosCompare.co.uk and other financial comparison websites.
What happens to everyone when the antagonist Staccato causes a certain effect, and what must Presto do in response?
Staccato causes everyone to become mute. Presto must search for the lost sounds and beat Staccato to return music to the world.
In Maestro! Jump in Music, how does pulling the string up or down affect Presto's movement, and what is the purpose of this mechanic?

By pulling down the string with the stylus, Presto will jump up (provided he is standing on it), while pulling it up will cause Presto to drop to another level. This is generally used as a means of changing paths in order to collect items that add to the beat.
根據這份家用電腦分類列表，主要分類與次要分類的依據分別是什麼？
根據片段，這份家用電腦分類列表主要分類是用家用電腦的CPU族系，次要分類是該CPU的字組寬度（8/16/32/64 bits）。
在8-bit家用電腦的MOS Technology 6502族中，Acorn電腦公司列出的型號有哪些？
在8-bit家用電腦的MOS Technology 6502族中，Acorn電腦公司列出的型號有Acorn Atom、Acorn Electron、BBC Micro（加了一個選用備配，更快, 6502外部共處理器的模組）以及BBC Master（65C02）。
According to the lab tutorial, what is the relationship between C programs and the libraries mentioned in the text?
The text states that these libraries are 'linked with all C programs by default — all you need to do is include the right header files.'
What does the tutorial say about the connection between a C program's file name and its contents, as illustrated by the example 'hw.c'?
The tutorial says, 'Unlike Java, there is not necessarily a connection between the file name and the contents of the file; thus, use your common sense.'
According to the passage, in which two scenarios does free-space management become more difficult and interesting due to variable-sized units?
This arises in a user-level memory-allocation library (as in malloc() and free()) and in an OS managing physical memory when using segmentation to implement virtual memory.
What does the Swahili word 'Tunapanda' mean, and where is the Tunapanda Institute based?
According to the text, 'Tunapanda' is a Swahili word meaning 'we are growing,' and the Tunapanda Institute is a United States based non-profit organization operating in East Africa.
What types of courses does Tunapanda Institute offer, and for whom, and what is the main location of its work?

The text states that Tunapanda Institute offers various free courses in technology, design and entrepreneurship to train disadvantaged young people, with the goal of increasing their chance in the labour market. The majority of its work is based in Kibera, a slum in Nairobi.
What is the fundamental problem in concurrent programming that locks are introduced to solve, according to the text?

According to the text, the fundamental problem in concurrent programming is that we would like to execute a series of instructions atomically, but due to the presence of interrupts on a single processor (or multiple threads executing on multiple processors concurrently), we couldn’t.
How do programmers use locks in source code to ensure critical sections execute as a single atomic instruction?
Programmers annotate source code with locks, putting them around critical sections, and thus ensure that any such critical section executes as if it were a single atomic instruction.
Who developed and who published Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus, and when was it released for the PC?
Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus is a turn-based tactics video game developed by Bulwark Studios and published by Kasedo Games for the PC in November 2018.
What is the role of Cognition points (CP) in the gameplay of Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus?
Cognition points (CP) dictate how many actions characters can take on their turn.
Who developed the VoteSpotter mobile app and what type of organization are they?
VoteSpotter was developed by the Mackinac Center for Public Policy, a free market-oriented think tank based in Michigan.
What was the original purpose of VoteSpotter in relation to MichiganVotes.org, and what does the app allow users to do?

VoteSpotter was originally an extension of the organization's MichiganVotes.org website, but has since expanded to include other states. The mobile app allows users to track votes by United States federal elected officials and state officials in select states.
What is the role of the client-side file system, and how does it handle a read() request as described in the passage?

The passage says: 'The role of the client-side ﬁle system is to execute the actions needed to service those system calls. For example, if the client issues a read() request, the client-side ﬁle system may send a message to the server-side ﬁle system (or, as it is commonly called, the ﬁle server) to read a partic- ular block; the ﬁle server will then read the block from disk (or its own in-memory c.' So the client-side file system executes actions to service system calls, and for a read() request, it sends a message to the file server to read a particular block, after which the file server reads that block from disk or its own in-memory cache.
According to the passage, what was the first concurrent program, and what must it do carefully?
The OS itself was the first concurrent program — it must access its own memory very carefully or many strange and terrible things will happen.
What is the title of this section and what is the version number of the operating systems material referenced in the passage?
The title of the section is 'Dialogue Concurrency'. The operating systems material referenced is 'OPERATING SYSTEMS [VERSION 1.10]' and it is from WWW.OSTEP.ORG.
What were the common complaints and praises from critics regarding the game Batman Returns on the Atari Lynx?

The game was met with mixed reception from critics; common complaints were towards the high level of difficulty, steep learning curve and repetitive gameplay, although it was praised for its presentation, detailed graphics and sound design.
In the gameplay of Batman Returns on the Atari Lynx, what type of game is it, who does the player control, and what is the objective?

Gameplay Batman Returns on the Atari Lynx is a side-scrolling action-beat 'em up game where players take control of Batman through four increasingly difficult stages fighting against multiple adversaries such as the Red Triangle Gang in order to stop both Catwoman and the Penguin from spreading terror across Goth.
What are the main components of the architecture described in RFC 2686 for low-bitrate links?

The main components of the architecture are: a real-time encapsulation format for asynchronous and synchronous low-bitrate links, a header compression architecture optimized for real-time flows, elements of negotiation protocols used between routers (or between hosts and routers), and announcement protocols used by applications to allow this negotiation to take place.
What is the general approach proposed in this document for the real-time encapsulation format part of the architecture?
The general approach is to start from the PPP Multilink fragmentation protocol [2] and provide a small number of extensions.
在技术性解释中，路由和转发分别指什么？
路由是決定封包由來源端到目的端所經過的路徑（host到host之間的傳輸路徑），這個过程称为路由；轉送是將路由器輸入端的封包移送至適當的路由器輸出端（在路由器內部進行），這稱為轉送。
What are the three key ideas about Operating Systems mentioned in the dialogue?
The three key ideas are virtualization, concurrency, and persistence.
According to the professor, why is the title of the book 'Three Easy Pieces' considered appropriate in relation to Physics?
The professor says this is appropriate, as Operating Systems are about half as hard as Physics.
緩衝閘的功能是什麼？它有哪些別稱？
緩衝閘是一種會輸出一個與輸入相同邏輯訊號的邏輯閘，是數位邏輯中實現緩衝或放大用的邏輯閘。它又稱同相器、同閘、是閘、驅動器或放大器。
緩衝閘在數位電路中有哪些實際應用？請根據資料片段說明。

緩衝閘的實際應用包括：一個微弱的信號源可以透過緩衝閘而增強訊號；緩衝閘有時作為數位中繼器；因為緩衝閘與其他邏輯閘一樣都有延遲，所以有時被做為數位電路的訊號延遲元件；此外，若邏輯閘的扇出數不足，可以在中間串接一個緩衝閘，由於緩衝閘不會使電路的邏輯行為發生改變，因此此舉可以確保電路的邏輯行為正確無誤；在單純NMOS或PMOS的邏輯電路中也可以使用緩衝閘來減少PMOS對高電平的電壓降與NMOS對低電平的電壓升。
What is the general architecture described in RFC 2491?
This document describes a general architecture for IPv6 over NBMA networks.
How are dynamic NBMA shortcuts achieved according to the document?
Dynamic NBMA shortcuts are achieved through the use of IPv6 Neighbor Discovery protocol operation within Logical Links, and inter-router NHR.
According to the RFC 1093 excerpt, where and when was the final discussion held before the document was produced?
The final discussion was held at the IBM T.J. Watson Research Center in Yorktown, NY, on the 21st of March 1988.
Who attended the Yorktown meeting mentioned in the RFC 1093 excerpt?
The Yorktown meeting was attended by Hans-Werner Braun (Merit), Scott Brim (Cornell University), Mark Fedor (NYSERNet), Jeff Honig (Cornell University), and Jacob Rekhter (IBM).
OpenBSD基金会是由哪个计划成立的，属于什么性质的组织？
OpenBSD基金会是由OpenBSD计划成立的一个加拿大非营利组织。
OpenBSD基金会除了作为OpenBSD的法律实体外，还作为哪些附属于OpenBSD的计划的法律保障？
它也可作为其他附属于OpenBSD的计划的法律保障，包括OpenSSH、OpenBGPD、OpenNTPD、OpenCVS、OpenSMTPD及LibreSSL。
What is the copyright notice stated in RFC 5441, and who holds the rights?

The copyright notice states: 'Copyright (c) 2009 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors. All rights reserved.' This document is subject to BCP 78 and the IETF Trust's Legal Provisions Relating to IETF Documents in effect on the date of publication of this document.
According to RFC 5441, what restrictions apply to material published or made publicly available before November 10, 2008?

The document states: 'This document may contain material from IETF Documents or IETF Contributions published or made publicly available before November 10, 2008. The person(s) controlling the copyright in some of this material may not have granted the IETF Trust the right to allow modifications of such material.'
根据片段，静态应用程序安全测试（SAST）和动态应用程序安全测试（DAST）各自的特点是什么？

静态应用程序安全测试（SAST）在应用程序开发过程中分析安全漏洞的源代码，与 DAST 相比，甚至可以在应用程序处于可执行状态之前使用，由于可以访问完整的源代码，它是一种白盒方法，可产生更详细的结果但可能导致许多需要手动验证的误报。动态应用程序安全测试（DAST，通常称为漏洞扫描器）通过抓取和分析网站自动检测漏洞，具有高度可扩展性、易于集成和快速的特点，非常适合处理低级攻击（如注入缺陷），但不太适合检测高级缺陷（如逻辑或业务逻辑缺陷）。
What is the main purpose of the document described in the fragment?

The document is intended to protect signaling between the home agent and the mobile node. It discusses the requirements defined in the Mobile IPv6 base document in more depth, illustrates the used packet formats, describes suitable configuration procedures, and shows how implementations can process the packets in the right order.
According to the table of contents listed in the fragment, which sections are included in the document?

The table of contents includes: 1. Introduction, 2. Terminology, 3. Packet Formats, which is further divided into 3.1 Binding Updates and Acknowledgements, 3.2 Return Routability Signaling, and 3.3 P (as shown in the fragment).
Prima（普萊瑪）是由哪家公司以什麼語音合成引擎為基礎開發販售的虛擬女性歌手軟體？
Prima（普萊瑪）是Zero-G以VOCALOID語音合成引擎為基礎開發販售的虛擬女性歌手軟體。
What is the purpose of the select() or poll() system calls in an event-based server?
What these interfaces enable a program to do is simple: check whether there is any incoming I/O that should be attended to.

In this document, a number of popular extensions to the Network News Transfer Protocol (NNTP) protocol defined in RFC 977 are documented and discussed. While this document is not intended to serve as a standard of any kind, it will hopefully serve as a reference document for future implementations.

This memo provides information for the Internet community. It does not specify an Internet standard of any kind. Distribution of this memo is unlimited.
Ethash 共识算法的设计目标是什么？其采用的主要方法是什么？
Ethash 已被設計為抵制ASIC，主要方法為藉著極大量的隨機查表，加重記憶體的負載，ASIC無法再利用專用線路而加速。
在 Ethash 中，矿工和轻客户端在存储数据方面有何不同？
礦工會存儲整個dataset和cache，而輕客户端只需要存儲cache。
Arthur Whitney 因开发哪些编程语言而最为著名？
Arthur Whitney 最为著名的是他开发了三种受APL启发的编程语言：A+, k, 和q。
Arthur Whitney 联合创办了哪些公司？
Arthur Whitney 联合创办了美国公司Kx Systems和Shakti Software。

The contents of registers is represented in a data-path diagram by a trapezoid containing a name for the operation.

The test checks whether the contents of register b is zero. A test has arrows from its input registers and constants, but it has no output arrows; its value is used.

messages.content: 網路口碑的特性有哪些？
網路口碑的特處，在於具有多對多、便利性、不受時空限制、匿名等特性。
目前網路口碑的研究方向分為哪三類？
目前網路口碑的研究方向分為三類：分別是1.網路口碑的傳撥行為、2.網路口碑的搜尋行為、3.網路口碑如何改變購買決策。
连环信中的诅咒贴在形式上有什么特点？
诅咒贴的形式相较连环信更单一。其开头一般为一则恐怖小故事，在结尾处威胁看到该贴的人若不转发几条就会有噩运降临。也有一些诅咒贴亦会引诱读者转发之后就会万事如意。一些转发的人还会在复制内容后加上“我也是被逼无奈”的字样。
根据片段，在中华人民共和国散发诅咒贴或连环信可能涉及哪些法律后果？
散发此类信件违反《中华人民共和国刑法》第293条寻衅滋事罪，该条第2项提到“恐吓他人，情节恶劣的”属刑事违法行为。此外，对于情节轻的没有达到刑事处罚的情况，《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》第四十二条规定，写恐吓信或者以其他方法威胁他人人身安全的，处五日以下拘留或者五百元以下罚款；情节较重的，处五日以上十日以下拘留，可以并处五百元以下罚款。
资料中提到的“互联网网关设备协议”相关内容涉及哪些具体技术或标准？
资料提到了 Universal Plug and Play NAT Traversal FAQ（Microsoft 发布）以及 MiniUPnP，后者支持 UPnP IGD 和 PCP/PMP 协议，并涉及网络地址转换（NAT）和网络协议。
香港增補字符集是由哪個機構負責管理，且該機構的簡稱是什麼？
負責整套字符集管理的為中文-{界面}-諮詢委員會（Chinese Language Interface Advisory Committee，CLIAC），簡稱「中諮會」。
根據《培根大爆炸》的資料，這道料理的製作過程和食材有哪些特點？

根據資料，培根大爆炸的製作過程「僅需要最低限度的烹飪才華」，而且備料十分簡單。食材包括：厚切培根910克、義大利香腸910克、燒烤醬一罐以及適量的調味料。培根首先編織成格紋狀，準備進行調味。完成調味後，在培根上方鋪上一層香腸肉，再以培根絞肉點綴。接著，在肉餚表面塗上燒烤醬，並補足燒烤調味料，隨後捲起，塑形成巨大的捲狀。肉捲根據厚度而有不同的烹烤時間，每英吋約需一小時。在燒烤時，可適量補充燒烤醬。肉捲烤熟後，切片，即可享用。
培根大爆炸的熱量與脂肪含量是多少，以及它竄紅後出現了哪些改造料理？
完整一道培根大爆炸料理的熱量高達5000卡路里（2.1萬千焦耳），並含有至少500克的脂肪。即使僅取用一人份（約8盎司），也有878卡路里和60克的脂肪。培根大爆炸在竄紅後，相繼出現許多改造料理。例如，「培根大爆炸重遊」便在原食材加入維菲塔乳酪（velveeta）和其他三種肉類，有的版本則選用墨西哥青辣椒和雞蛋，創造不同風味的培根大爆炸。
What does the student mention as a neat idea that combines SJF and RR in a scheduler?
That you can build a smart scheduler that tries to be like SJF and RR all at once — that MLFQ was pretty neat.
According to the professor, why is there still controversy over which scheduler to use, and what examples does he cite?

Indeed it is. That’s why there is still controversy to this day over which scheduler to use; see the Linux battles between CFS, BFS, and the O(1) scheduler, for example. And no, I will not spell out the full name of BFS.
《蟲籠的卡伽斯特爾》這部漫畫作品最初是在哪裡以什麼筆名進行創作的？
2005年9月14日於作者個人網站「チキンの魂」以橋本チキン為筆名進行創作。
在《蟲籠的卡伽斯特爾》的劇情簡介中，『卡伽斯特爾』疾病發作後會導致什麼後果？
一旦發病就會失去人格，身體變為巨大的昆蟲而後吞噬人類，並通過和同樣的蟲子進行繁殖來增加數量。
在DHCP协议中，消息操作代码（Op）字段可以表示哪两种操作？
Op：消息操作代码，既可以是引导请求（BOOTREQUEST）也可以是引导答复（BOOTREPLY）。
DHCP客户在获得一个IP地址后，如何避免由于DHCP服务器地址池重叠而引发的IP冲突？
客户在获得了一个IP地址以后，就可以发送一个ARP请求来避免由于DHCP服务器地址池重叠而引发的IP冲突。
What are the two main challenges mentioned when building CPU virtualization machinery?

The first is performance: how can we implement virtualization without adding excessive overhead to the system? The second is control: how can we run processes efficiently while retaining control over the CPU?
According to the fragment, what is the basic idea for virtualizing the CPU, and what is achieved by doing so?
The basic idea is simple: run one process for a little while, then run another one, and so forth. By time sharing the CPU in this manner, virtualization is achieved.
According to the passage, what are the two different aspects of file systems that one should understand to grasp how the file system basically works?

According to the passage, the two different aspects of file systems are the data structures of the file system and the other aspect implied by the phrase 'if you understand both of these aspects'—specifically, the passage states: 'The first is the data structures of the file system. In other words, what types of on-disk structures are utilized by the file system to organize its data and metadata?' and it suggests that understanding both aspects leads to understanding how the file system basically works, but the second aspect is not explicitly named in the provided fragment; however, the fragment only explicitly details the first aspect.
What types of on-disk structures are mentioned as being utilized by the first file systems, such as vsfs?
The passage states: 'The first file systems we’ll see (including vsfs below) employ simple structures, like arrays of blocks or other objects.'
According to the passage, why do people in the real world trust their friends and relatives with secrets or access to their home and car?
That’s not so much because you have perfect mechanisms to prevent those trusted parties from behaving badly, but because you are pretty sure they won’t.
What can a person do if they are wrong about a trusted party's behavior, based on the passage?
If you’re wrong, perhaps you can detect that they haven’t behaved well and take compensating actions (like changing your locks or calling...).

NetworkX is described as 'e, highly portable framework for network and social network analysis.'
Into which software is NetworkX integrated according to the text?
NetworkX is integrated into SageMath.
Who developed and who published the 2018 action-adventure game Just Cause 4, and on which platforms and date was it released?
Just Cause 4 was developed by Avalanche Studios and published by Square Enix. It was released for PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One on 4 December 2018.
What role does the player assume in Just Cause 4, and what new technology feature does the game's engine allow?

In the game, the player assumes the role of series protagonist Rico Rodríguez who arrives in the fictional nation of Solís to take down The Black Hand, the world's biggest private military. The game uses a new version of Avalanche's Apex game engine, and the new technology allows the game to feature diverse and extreme weather effects, including blizzards, sandstorms, tornadoes and more.
According to the fragment, what are the two possible states of a lock, and what does each state indicate?

The fragment states that a lock can be in one of two states: '(or unlocked or free) and thus no thread holds the lock, or acquired (or locked or held), and thus exactly one thread holds the lock and presumably is in a critical section.'

What was BeatThatQuote.com and when was it disabled?
BeatThatQuote.com was a British price comparison site specializing in personal finance products. The site was disabled in 2013 after being acquired by Google.
Who launched BeatThatQuote.com and in which year, and what was its revenue for the financial year 2006 to 2007?
BeatThatQuote.com was launched by John Paleomylites in February 2005 based in London's Kentish Town. In the financial year 2006 to 2007 the company posted revenues of £7.8 million.
根據片段，Python 3 中引入的關鍵字 nonlocal 和 global 各自的功能是什麼？

Who developed the puzzle video game Hot Pixel and when was it released in Europe?
Hot Pixel was developed by French studio zSlide, and it was released on 22 June 2007 in Europe.
What did Jeff Gerstmann of GameSpot criticize about Hot Pixel in his review?
Jeff Gerstmann of GameSpot gave Hot Pixel 6.5 out of 10, criticizing misleading advertisement of 200+ minigames and its close resemblance to WarioWare series.
Zameen.com在2015年9月的第二轮融资中募集了多少资金，其2016年1月宣布的C轮融资金额是多少？
2015年9月的第二轮融资中，Zameen.com从3家知名国际基金募集了900万美元。2016年1月，该网站宣布在C轮融资中融资2000万美元。

据报道，截至2018年3月，该网站的用户超过500万，房源超过1100万套，并有14500名注册代理人。
盧廣弘在2009年6月27日以哪張專輯獲頒第20屆金曲獎的哪些獎項？
他以《100種生活》獲頒第20屆金曲獎最佳新人獎和最佳作曲人獎等獎項。
盧廣仲在2017年參與植劇場飾演哪個角色，並因此獲得第53屆金鐘獎的哪些獎項？
他參與植劇場，飾演鄭花甲一角，並憑該角色演出獲頒第53屆金鐘獎戲劇節目男主角獎、戲劇節目最具潛力新人獎等獎項。
Besides payment processing, what other business areas has Heartland developed or acquired according to the text?

In addition to payment processing, Heartland has developed or acquired businesses in payroll processing, gift card and campus card, point of sale systems, school payments and nutrition, network management, mobile payments and ordering, eCommerce, billing, and lending services.
What were the two key historical events for Heartland involving a private equity investment and going public, and when did they occur?

In 2001 the company received a $40 million private equity investment from Greenhill Capital Partners, L.P. (New York, NY), LLR Partners, Inc. (Philadelphia, PA), and their affiliated investment funds. The company went public on the New York Stock Exchange on August 11, 2005.
Shazam娛樂有限公司於何年由誰創建？
Shazam娛樂有限公司於1999年由克里斯·巴頓、菲利浦·英格布雷克特、艾佛利·王、迪拉吉·穆克吉和馬克·安東尼·哈希創建。
截至2014年8月，Shazam的使用規模和2017年12月的收購情況分別是什麼？
截至2014年8月，Shazam已有超過1億，並應用於超過5億台行動裝置。2017年12月，該公司正式被蘋果以四億美元收購，成為蘋果公司旗下部門。
What officially happened to Pokémon Trading Card Game Online on June 7, 2023?
On June 7, 2023 PTCGO officially shut down.
In the Trainer Challenge mode, what do players compete against, and what is the mode recommended for?

In the Trainer Challenge mode, the player competes against a range of computer-controlled characters using pre-constructed theme decks. This is one of the easiest modes in the game, so is recommended for newer players.
根据资料，自我复制是动力系统的一种行为，这种行为可以产生出什么？
自我复制是动力系统的一种行为，这种行为可以产生出和自身相同的结构。
在细胞分裂的过程中，DNA完成了什么，并且可以通过什么传递给后代？
在细胞分裂的过程中，DNA完成了自我复制，并且可以通过繁殖传递给后代。
What is the purpose of the network proxy specified in RFC 8766?

The purpose of the network proxy specified in RFC 8766 is to use Multicast DNS to automatically populate the wide-area unicast Domain Name System namespace with records describing devices and services found on the local link.
Which platforms and game genres are listed as categories for this game in the reference section?

The listed categories include Apple II games, Commodore 64 games, computer wargames, Strategic Studies Group games, turn-based strategy video games, video games about Nazi Germany, video games developed in Australia, video games set in the Soviet Union, and World War II video games.
