What is the major problem associated with using large pages, as described in the Vm Smalltables material?

The major problem with this approach, however, is that big pages lead to waste within each page, a problem known as internal fragmentation (as the waste is internal to the unit of allocation). Applications thus end up allocating pages but only using little bits and pieces of each, and memory quickly fills up with these overly-large pages.
According to the text, why are large pages sometimes most easily used, and what is the direct effect on page table size?

Large pages are sometimes most easily used simply by exporting a new interface to applications to request large pages directly. The effect is a reduction in size of the page table, and the reduction exactly mirrors the factor of four increase in page size (e.g., a factor of four reduction in page table size for a factor of four increase in page size).
According to the passage, what is the definition of advertising to children?
Advertising to children refers to the act of advertising products or services to children as defined by national laws and advertising standards.
What age range does UNESCO define as early childhood, and what age is commonly used as a cut-off point in advertising law?
UNESCO defines early childhood as ages 0–8 years. For the purposes of advertising law, the age of 12 is commonly used as a cut-off point.
根据片段，Mac OS X 10.2导入的plist新格式是什么？这种格式从哪个版本开始成为偏好设置文件的默认格式？
Mac OS X 10.2导入了一种新的格式，它将plist文件存储为二进制文件。从Mac OS X 10.4开始，这是偏好设置文件的默认格式。
片段中提到，plutil工具和Property List Editor分别有哪些功能？
plutil工具（在Mac OS X 10.2中导入）可以用来检查plist的语法，或者对plist文件进行格式转换。Property List Editor是Apple提供的应用程序（作为Apple Developer Tools的一部分安装），它是一个树状的查看器与编辑器，并可以处理二进制格式的plist。
According to the fragment, what is the key difference between threads and processes regarding the stack?

One other major difference between threads and processes concerns the stack. In our simple model of the address space of a classic process (which we can now call a single-threaded process), there is a single stack segment, but in a multi-threaded address space, as shown in Figure 26.1, there are multiple stacks, each associated with a thread (e.g., Stack (1) and Stack (2)).
What are the three segments mentioned in the fragment and what does each contain?

The three segments are: the code segment: where instructions live; the heap segment: contains malloc’d data dynamic data structures (it grows positively); and the stack segment: contains local variables arguments to routines, return values, etc. (it grows negatively).
In the code snippet from Figure 5.2, what does the child process do immediately after fork() returns a value of 0?
If rc == 0, the child (new process) executes the line: printf("child (pid:%d)\n", (int) getpid());
According to the text, in what way is the child process not an exact copy of its parent after fork()?
The child isn't an exact copy. Specifically, although it now has its own copy of the address space (i.e., its own private memory), its own registers, its own PC, and so forth, the value it returns to
According to the provided excerpt from RFC 6249, what is the status of this document in terms of its publication track?

This is an Internet Standards Track document. This document is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). It represents the consensus of the IETF community. It has received public review and has been approved for publication by the Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG).
Where can information about the current status of RFC 6249, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it be obtained, as stated in the excerpt?
Information about the current status of this document, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it may be obtained at http://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc6249.
According to RFC 7818, which group approved the document for publication after it received public review?
It has received public review and has been approved for publication by the Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG).
Where can information about the current status of RFC 7818, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it be obtained?
Information about the current status of this document, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it may be obtained at http://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc7818.
According to the fragment, what does a single line that when active (logic zero) indicate about the device?
A single line that when active (logic zero) indicates the device is being written by the CPU.
What does the Transfer ACK ('acknowledgement') line deliver information about, as stated in the fragment?
Transfer ACK ('acknowledgement') delivers information that the data was acknowledged (read) by the device.
According to the passage, what is the limitation of the operating system's control over hardware?

It has substantial control over a limited domain – the hardware on which it runs, using the interfaces of which it is given control. It has no real control over what happens on other machines, nor what happens if one of its pieces of hardware is accessed via some mechanism outside the operating system’s control.
What is the suggested answer when the operating system does not itself control access to a resource that it needs to protect?
The answer is to prepare the resource for trouble in advance.
在組合技巧中，計數原理包括哪些原理？它們常用於解決什麼問題？
計數原理包括加法原理、乘法原理、容斥原理，常用於解決組合計數問題。
根據片段，雙射法的用途是什麼？算兩次又是什麼技巧？
雙射法用於證明某兩類物件的數目一樣多，即構造兩類物件的集合之間的雙射（一一對應關係）。算兩次是證明恆等式的技巧，方法是分別證明左右兩式各自數算同一個集合的元素個數。
Thunderbolt 第二版（Thunderbolt 2）的同步傳輸速度是多少？其物理層面與第一版在頻寬上有何關係？
第二版（Thunderbolt 2）的同步傳輸速度是20 Gbit/s。物理層面，第一、二版 Thunderbolt 的頻寬都是 20 Gbit/s，因此線材是相容的。
Thunderbolt 2 在邏輯層面上是如何實現最高傳輸速度翻倍的？第一款引入 Thunderbolt 2 的產品是什麼？
邏輯層面，第二代 Thunderbolt 合併了第一代的兩條獨立 10 Gbit/s 通道，使得最高傳輸速度翻倍到 20 Gbit/s。第一款引入 Thunderbolt 2 的產品是ASUS主板，於2013年8月19日發佈。
What assumption about address spaces and physical memory is relaxed in the section 'Beyond Physical Memory: Mechanisms'?

The section relaxes the big assumptions that an address space is unrealistically small and fits into physical memory, and that every address space of every running process fits into memory. Instead, it assumes we wish to support many concurrently-running large address spaces.
What additional level in the memory hierarchy is required to support large address spaces, and what is the general purpose of that location?

To support large address spaces, the OS requires an additional level in the memory hierarchy. The general characteristics of such a location are that it provides a place to stash away portions of address spaces that currently aren’t in great demand.
What is the TLB and where is it located according to the fragment?

According to the fragment, a TLB is part of the chip’s memory-management unit (MMU), and is simply a hardware cache of popular virtual-to-physical address translations; thus, a better name would be an address-translation cache.
What does the hardware do upon each virtual memory reference, as described in the fragment?
Upon each virtual memory reference, the hardware first checks the TLB to see if the desired translation is present.
根据片段，执行Limbo代码的Dis虚拟机属于哪一类VM，并支持哪些高级数据类型？
执行Limbo代码的Dis虚拟机是CISC类的VM，具有的指令包括：算数、控制流、数据移动、进程创建、同步和进程间通信、装载代码模块的指令，并支持高级数据类型：字符串、数组、列表和通信通道。
Cal (Unix) 程式在Unix或類Unix操作系統中的主要功能是什麼？
是在Unix或類Unix操作系統中用作以文字形式列印月曆的程式，可以按命令行選項印出一個月、幾個月甚至整年的月曆。
根据资料片段，v8cgi 和 node.js 分别是什么？

v8cgi is a v8-based framework for serving web application written in JavaScript. node.js is a toolkit for writing performant non-blocking event-driven network servers in JavaScript. 即 v8cgi 是一个基于 v8 的框架，用于服务用 JavaScript 编写的 Web 应用；node.js 是一个工具包，用于编写用 JavaScript 编写的高性能非阻塞事件驱动网络服务器。
资料片段中提到了哪些与 V8 相关的项目或主题？

片段中提到的相关项目或主题包括：v8cgi（基于 v8 的框架）、node.js（用于编写非阻塞事件驱动网络服务器的工具包），以及“Inside V8 - A Javascript Virtual Machine”这一主题，还有参见的 Google Chrome、Chromium (浏览器)、JavaScriptCore、Dart、SpiderMonkey、即时编译、JavaScript引擎、虛擬機器，以及 Google軟體和使用BSD许可证的软件等标签。
According to the passage, what is the fastest access mode for accessing blocks on a disk?
Accessing blocks in a contiguous chunk (i.e., a sequential read or write) is the fastest access mode, and usually much faster than any more random access pattern.
In the basic geometry of a modern disk, what is a platter and what is a surface?

A platter is a circular hard surface on which data is stored persistently by inducing magnetic changes to it. A disk may have one or more platters; each platter has 2 sides, each of which is called a surface.
According to the passage, what are the two key requirements for a security access mechanism to be considered good?

The two key requirements are that it must be both correct and efficient. If it’s not correct, you make the wrong access decisions – obviously bad. Its efficiency is important because it will inject some overhead whenever it is used.
What principle from earlier chapters is mentioned in relation to checking security conditions, and what does that principle state?

The principle mentioned is the principle of complete mediation. That principle said we should check security conditions every time someone asked for something. The passage notes that we’ll need to balance costs against security benefits, but if we can find some beneficial special cases where we can achieve low cost without compromising security, we can possibly manage.
俄亥俄州立大学设立的纪念基金在2004年2月6日更名为什么？
2004年2月6日，根據其家族及工程學院的要求，將其遺孀的名字加進去，改名為“Dr. Michael Shih-Yuan and Anna Lee Chen Family Fund in Engineering”。
According to the passage, what is one reason why securing an operating system is difficult?

Securing an operating system is difficult because modern operating systems are large and complex, and the more code and the more complex the algorithms, the more likely the code is to contain flaws, which are the usual source of failures in software security.
What additional challenge in securing operating systems is mentioned besides their size and complexity?
Another challenge in securing operating systems is that they are, for the most part, meant to support multiple processes simultaneously.
What is the purpose of the status codes defined in RFC 3463?

For delivery status reports, tracking, and improved diagnostics. In combination with other information provided in the Delivery Status Notification (DSN) delivery report, these codes facilitate media and language independent rendering of message delivery status.
What are the section titles for the status code structure and the enumerated status codes in RFC 3463?
The section titles are '2. Status Code Structure' and '3. Enumerated Status Codes'.
漫画《這個僧侶有夠煩》是由誰創作的？它從什麼時候開始連載？
《這個僧侶有夠煩》是精心發酵所創作的日本漫畫，2019年7月31日起開始連載。
電視動畫《這個僧侶有夠煩》的動畫製作公司是哪一家？動畫於何時首播？
動畫製作公司定為壽門堂，改編電視動畫於2022年4月10日首播。
在 ICD-10 第九章的“其他类型的心脏病（I30-I52）”中，哪些条目明确标注了“分类于他处的疾病引起”的疾病？
在“其他类型的心脏病（I30-I52）”中，明确标注“分类于他处的疾病引起”的条目包括：I32 分类于他处的疾病引起的心包炎，I39 分类于他处的疾病引起的心内膜炎和心瓣膜疾患，I41 分类于他处的疾病引起的心肌炎，以及I43 分类于他处的疾病引起的心肌病。

messages.content: When was the third-generation Moto G unveiled and released?
The third-generation Moto G was unveiled in India on July 28, 2015 and released the same day.
What is the display size, resolution, and protective glass of the third-generation Moto G?
The third-generation Moto G has a 5-inch display with HD resolution of 1280x720p and features Corning Gorilla Glass 3.
When was FontLab's first macOS product released, and what was it called?
FontLab's first macOS product was FontLab 3 for Mac, in 1998.
What is TypeTool, and who is it popular with according to the text?

TypeTool is a simplified version of FontLab Studio, is quite inexpensive and serves as an entry-level typeface editor, which is popular with students, hobbyists, and those whose typographic needs are relatively simple.
Who approved RFC 9067 for publication after it received public review?
The Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG) approved RFC 9067 for publication after it received public review.
Where can information about the current status of RFC 9067, any errata, and how to provide feedback be obtained?
Information about the current status of this document, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it may be obtained at https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9067.
What was Magnuson Computer Systems known for manufacturing, and what was the name of its product range?

Magnuson Computer Systems was a manufacturer of plug-compatible computers compatible with IBM mainframes. The Magnuson M80 range was available from the late 1970s and was successful when IBM struggled to ship machines.
What was perhaps the most notable unique design feature of the Magnuson processors, and who served as Vice President of Engineering at Magnuson?

Perhaps the most notable unique design feature of the Magnuson processors was the voting logic on each processor card. Carlton Amdahl, son of Gene Amdahl, was Vice President of Engineering at Magnuson.
What type of software was Yosemite Server Backup and who developed it?
Yosemite Server Backup (YSB) was cross-platform backup software developed by Barracuda Networks, Inc.
What happened to Yosemite Server Backup as of September 30, 2017?
Yosemite Server Backup is no longer a stand alone package as of Sept. 30, 2017. It is now part of Barracuda Backup.
According to the provided text, what are three causes that lead to packets not reaching their destination?

According to the text, bit corruption, down or non-working links and machines, and lack of buffer space for incoming packets all lead to the same result: packets sometimes do not reach their destination.
According to the passage, what is the central problem regarding security access control in file open system calls?

The central problem is: 'How can the operating system decide if a particular request made by a particular process belonging to...' (as stated in the heading 'THE CRUX OF THE PROBLEM: HOW TO DETERMINE IF AN ACCESS REQUEST SHOULD BE GRANTED?'). The passage emphasizes that the system must ensure the file is not opened if the security policy forbids it, but equally ensure it is opened if the policy allows it.
What opportunity does the system call provide to the operating system for making a security decision, according to the passage?

The passage states: 'We know that the system call will trap to the operating system, giving it the opportunity to do something to make this decision.' Mechanically, this 'something' refers to the action the operating system takes upon the trap to evaluate the access request against the security policy.
Zend Studio对哪些语言提供调试支持？
Zend Studio是Zend Technologies开发的PHP语言集成开发环境（Integrated Development Environment IDE)。也支持HTML和JavaScript标签，但只对PHP语言提供调试支持。
Zend Studio在调试分析方面，如何设置断点以及断点执行后的表现是什么？
右击左面灰色区域，可以设置断点，PHP代码执行到断点处后会自动终止，并在Debug界面显示出PHP程序执行过程中的相关信息。
Netwide Assembler（NASM）是基于什么架构的汇编与反汇编工具？它可以编写哪些位数的程序？
Netwide Assembler（简称 NASM）是一款基于英特尔 x86 架构的汇编与反汇编工具。它可以用来编写 16位、32位（IA-32）和 64位（x86-64）的程序。
NASM 可以输出哪些二进制格式，其中地址无关代码仅支持哪种对象文件？
NASM 可以输出包括 COFF、OMF、a.out、可执行与可链接格式（ELF）、Mach-O 和二进制文件（.bin，二进制磁盘映像，用于编译操作系统）等多种二进制格式，而地址无关代码仅支持 ELF 对象文件。
FC磁碟機是由哪家公司於何時推出的家用遊戲機硬體？其儲存媒介是什麼？
FC磁碟機是日本電子遊戲商任天堂於1986年2月推出的家用遊戲機硬體，為任天堂於1983年發售的8位元家用遊戲機FC遊戲機（俗稱紅白機）的外接配件之一。FC磁碟機以軟碟為儲存媒介。
FC磁碟機的軟碟儲存空間相較於當時大多數家用遊戲機所使用的卡帶有何優勢？其生命週期終結的標誌事件是什麼？
軟碟的儲存空間較當時大多數家用遊戲機所使用的卡帶大上許多，使FC磁碟機遊戲之畫面表現及音效多較同期之紅白機遊戲豐富。2003年9月，任天堂終止軟碟改寫服務。2007年10月，FC磁碟機本體維修服務亦告終止，宣告主機生命週期正式終結。
According to the passage, what is the crucial problem in developing a scheduling policy?

The crucial problem is: HOW TO DEVELOP SCHEDULING POLICY. Specifically, it asks: How should we develop a basic framework for thinking about scheduling policies? What are the key assumptions? What metrics are important? What basic approaches have been used in the earliest of computer systems?
What are the processes running in the system collectively called, and why is determining this considered critical?

The processes running in the system are collectively called the workload. Determining the workload is a critical part of building policies, as stated in the passage: 'Determining the workload is a critical part of building policies.'
What is the title and purpose of RFC 9080?

The title is 'Homenet Profile of the Babel Routing Protocol'. Its purpose is to define the exact subset of the Babel routing protocol and its extensions that is required by an implementation of the Homenet protocol suite, as well as the interactions between the Home Networking Control Protocol (HNCP) and Babel.
According to the document, who authored RFC 9080 and what is its status?

The document was authored by J. Chroboczek, affiliated with IRIF, University of Paris-Diderot. Its status is 'Internet Standards Track document' and it is a product of the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), representing the consensus of the IETF community.
战斧F1是什么公司开发的什么设备？它于何时陆续发货？
战斧F1，是中華人民共和國斧子科技开发的家用游戏机，于2016年6月1日陆续发货，是中国大陆撤销游戏机禁令后第一个中国大陆制作且发售了的游戏主机品牌。但同年11月底北京公司倒閉，2019年伺服器也關閉，遊戲機再也無法聯網進入系統。
根据资料，战斧F1的开发背景中，王峰和张晓威分别有怎样的经历，以及他们是如何合作创办斧子公司的？

早期就职于金山軟件的王峰，2007年離開金山後創辦藍港互動公司製作一些輕量網頁遊戲為主業績，聽聞遊戲機市場將獲准開放後決定製作國產主機。此時華為的產品經理張曉威早期在公司內負責安卓機上盒相關產品，然而公司支持力度並不大產品表現一般，之後其提議增加機上盒配置將其作為安卓基礎的一款電視遊戲機，名為TRON主機專案，然而公司內雖然批准但其在華為內獲得支持並不高屬於公司內不得志的部門，王峰見此機會透過人脈將張曉威挖角，兩人共同創辦斧子公司。
聯發科技是一家什麼樣的公司？它於何時成立，總部位於何處？
聯發科技是一家為無線通訊、高清電視設計系统芯片的無廠半導體公司。公司成立於1997年，總部位於新竹科學園區。
聯發科技在2013年和2016年分別成為全球第幾大無晶圓廠IC設計商？並說明其初期主要產品是什麼？
2013年聯發科技成為全球第四大無晶圓廠IC設計商，2016年成為全球第三大。聯發科技初期主要產品為CD-ROM晶片組。
太初核合成理论描述的是什么内容？
太初核合成理论定性并定量描述宇宙早期形成的氢元素丰度，该理论所预言的宇宙早期快速膨胀并冷却过程中最初的几分钟内通过核反应所形成的元素的理论丰度值，与观测到的元素丰度非常接近。
大爆炸一词首先是由谁采用的，他当时持有什么观点？
大爆炸一词首先是由英国天文学家弗雷德·霍伊尔所采用的，霍伊尔是与大爆炸对立的宇宙学模型——穩態理論的倡导者。
街聲平台是由哪家公司所屬，並於何時在何地創立？創辦人是誰？
街聲為中子創新所屬用户生成内容（UGC）免費線上音樂及社群平台，2006年於台北市創立，創辦人為張培仁。
根据资料片段，爱因斯坦和玻尔在对待物理学的目标上有何不同？
爱因斯坦认为，物理学应该能告诉他在公式背后的真实世界发生了什么。而玻尔只对公式本身感兴趣而不关心那潜在的现实世界中的事件。
根据资料片段，玻尔在光量子假说上的态度有何变化？他的哪些成就基于这个观点？
玻尔一直是光量子假说的最坚定的反对者之一，直到1925年他才接受这个观点。玻尔后来创造性的成就却基于一个被他长期反对的观点，这在科学史中极其少见。
What is a certificate revocation list (CRL) according to the provided text?

In cryptography, a certificate revocation list (or CRL) is "a list of digital certificates that have been revoked by the issuing certificate authority (CA) before their scheduled expiration date and should no longer be trusted".
According to RFC 5280, what are the two different states of revocation, and what is an example of when a certificate is irreversibly revoked?

According to RFC 5280, the two different states of revocation are Revoked and (the other state, though not explicitly named in the text, is implied as the opposite; the text states: "There are two different states of revocation defined in RFC 5280: Revoked"). A certificate is irreversibly revoked if, for example, it is discovered that the certificate authority (CA) had improperly issued a certificate, or if a private-key is thought to be compromised.
According to the AFS description in the passage, what is the result of file operations after a file is cached locally, and what happens upon close()?

According to the passage, once a file is cached to the local file system where the file is stored, operations on it require no network communication and are fast. Finally, upon close(), the file (if it has been modified) is flushed back to the server.
In the C++ class example that acts like a monitor, what is the purpose of acquiring and releasing the lock in both deposit() and withdraw() methods?
Basically, it is just acquiring a lock and releasing it. By doing so, we achieve what the monitor requires: only one thread will be active within deposit() or withdraw().
According to the text, what is the exact same goal accomplished by the C++ class example compared to the monitor class described above?

According to the text, the C++ class example accomplishes the exact same goal as the monitor class above, because it is just acquiring a lock and releasing it, thereby ensuring only one thread will be active within deposit() or withdraw().
What is the status of RFC 6734 according to the document?
RFC 6734 has received public review and has been approved for publication by the Internet Engineering Steering Group (IESG).
Where can information about the current status of this document, any errata, and how to provide feedback be obtained?
Information about the current status of this document, any errata, and how to provide feedback on it may be obtained at http://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc6734.
What does RFC 4052 specify regarding its status according to the memo?
This document specifies an Internet Best Current Practices for the Internet Community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements. Distribution of this memo is unlimited.
What is the main subject discussed in the abstract of RFC 4052?

This document discusses the procedures used by the IAB to establish and maintain liaison relationships between the IETF and other Standards Development Organizations (SDOs), consortia and industry fora.
斯托曼为了创建一个完全由自由软件组成的类Unix计算机操作系统，在何时推出了GNU项目？
为了创建一个完全由自由软件组成的类Unix计算机操作系统，斯托曼在1983年9月推出了GNU项目。

The purpose of the IGP extension is for Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) Security Capability Support in PCE Discovery (PCED), allowing a Path Computation Element (PCE) that is a Label Switching Router (LSR) or a server participating in the Interior Gateway Protocol (IGP) to advertise its presence and path computation capabilities using IGP flooding, as defined in the IGP extensions for PCE Discovery (RFCs 5088 and 5089).
According to RFC 9353, which documents does it update?
RFC 9353 updates RFCs 5088, 5089, 8231, and 8306, as stated in the header: 'Updates: 5088, 5089, 8231, 8306'.
在电子游戏领域，哪些例子被资料用来说明“同一批开发者或工作室创作的新系列作品会被视为过去作品的精神续作”？
如FromSoftware开发的《恶魔之魂》和《黑暗之魂》，后者视为前者的精神续作，两者皆是黑暗奇幻主题，美术风格和玩法类似。又如《雙點醫院》的制作人、设计师及程序师本·荷姆斯都是1997年发行的同类游戏《杏林也瘋狂》的牛蛙工作室开发者，而拥有《杏林也瘋狂》商标的牛蛙工作室被美商艺电收购后解散，美商艺电拥有版权但无意开发续作，因此原开发者在离开牛蛙工作室后仅能以新名称开发精神续作。
In Lifelong Planning A*, what are the definitions of predecessors and successors for a node, and do they include indirect connections?

With the exception of the start and goal node, each node has predecessors and successors: Any node from which an edge leads towards is a predecessor of . Any node to which an edge leads from is a successor of . In the following description, these two terms refer only to the immediate predecessors and successors, not to predecessors of predecessors or successors of successors.
What two estimates of the start distance does LPA* maintain for each node, and how is the lookahead value defined?

LPA* maintains two estimates of the start distance for each node: , the previously calculated g-value (start distance) as in A* , a lookahead value based on the g-values of the node’s predecessors (the minimum of all , where {{math|n'''}} is a predecessor of and is the cost of the edge.
What problem do cloud storage gateways address for classic applications that use object storage?

Classic applications use network attached storage by means of Network File System NFS, iSCSI or Server Message Block SMB. To make use of all the advantages of object storage, existing applications need to be rewritten, and new applications must be object storage aware, which is not the case by default. This problem is addressed by cloud storage gateways.
How do cloud storage gateways provide access to object storage for classic applications, and what protocols do they typically support?

Cloud storage gateways offer object storage via classic native storage protocols like Network File System NFS or Server Message Block SMB (and a very few offer iSCSI as well). As a rule of thumb, classic applications with cloud native object storage can now be used with cloud storage gateways.
What is an orphan work, and why does it often prevent the work from being used or digitized?

An orphan work is a work whose copyright owner is impossible to identify or contact. This inability to request permission from the copyright owner often means orphan works cannot be used in new works nor digitized, except when fair use exceptions apply.

meta.title: Orphan works in the United States

messages.content: According to the passage, what did much of the early research on concurrency bugs focus on?
Much of the early work focused on deadlock, a topic which we’ve touched on in the past chapters but will now dive into deeply.
What does the passage state about the nature of concurrency bugs in terms of patterns?
Concurrency bugs tend to come in a variety of common patterns. Knowing which ones to look for is the central issue of the chapter, as stated in the CRUX: HOW TO HANDLE COMMON CONCURRENCY BUGS.
According to the professor, what is the best way for the student to learn about fractions?

The professor says, "I think there is no substitute for doing; just reading about these things doesn’t quite give you the proper sense. Do the class projects and I bet by the end it will all kind of make sense."
How does the student describe the philosophy of the OS after trying to understand its basic machinery?

The student says, "It seems like the OS is fairly paranoid. It wants to make sure it stays in charge of the machine. While it wants a program to run as efficiently as possible (and hence the whole reasoning behind limited direct execution)."
MonoDevelop 主要用来开发哪些软件？其适用于哪些操作系统？
MonoDevelop 主要用来开发 Mono 与 .NET Framework 软件，适用于 Linux、Mac OS X 和 Microsoft Windows。
根据片段，MonoDevelop 的 Mac OS X 版本为何没有包含 Stetic 视觉化设计工具？
因为原生 OS X 平台 GTK 的拖拉问题，所以 MonoDevelop 的 Mac OS X 版本没有包含 Stetic 视觉化设计工具。
在阴影贴图技术中，深度图在什么情况下必须重新更新？在哪些场合下可以重复使用？
一旦场景中的光源或者物体发生变动，就必须重新更新深度图，但是在其它场合下也可以重复使用深度图，例如只有照相机运动的场合。
在阴影贴图技术中，场景着色过程的第二步主要分为哪三个部分？
第二步就是使用阴影图按照普通的透视投影绘制场景。这个过程分为三个主要的部分，第一是找出物体在光照视景中的坐标，第二是将这个坐标与深度图中的对应值进行比较，最后就是根据处于阴影或者光照下的位置将物体绘制出来。
What problem did IBM face with its expensive mainframes years ago, and what solution did it introduce?

The problem was that an organization might want to run different operating systems on the machine at the same time, because some applications had been developed on one OS and some on others. As a solution, IBM introduced yet another level of indirection in the form of a virtual machine monitor (VMM), also called a hypervisor.
According to the text, where does the virtual machine monitor sit, and what illusion does it give to each running operating system?

The monitor sits between one or more operating systems and the hardware. It gives the illusion to each running OS that it controls the machine. Behind the scenes, however, the monitor actually is in control of the hardware.
What is described as the canonical update of a shared variable in the provided text?
The canonical update of a shared variable is: balance = balance + 1;
According to the text, what must you declare to use a lock, and what does this variable hold?
To use a lock, you must declare a lock variable of some kind (such as mutex). This lock variable (or just 'lock' for short) holds the state of the lock at any instant in time. It is either available.
Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime 被稱為什麼？它於何時推出？
Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime 是世上首部採用四核心處理器的平板電腦，於2011年12月1日推出。
Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime 的硬件規格包括哪些處理器、記憶體和儲存容量？
Asus Eee Pad Transformer Prime 使用 NVIDIA Tegra 3 1.4 GHz 四核心處理器、1 GB 記憶體、32 或 64 GB 快閃記憶體儲存。
What does RFC 1472 define a portion of, and for what purpose?
This memo defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in TCP/IP-based internets.
What is the status of this memo according to the document, and what does it request?
This RFC specifies an IAB standards track protocol for the Internet community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements.
What is the basic concept of a proportional-share scheduler according to the fragment?
Instead of optimizing for turnaround or response time, a scheduler might instead try to guarantee that each job obtain a certain percentage of CPU time.
What is the name of the early example of proportional-share scheduling mentioned in the fragment, and who researched it?
An excellent early example of proportional-share scheduling is found in research by Waldspurger and Weihl [WW94], and is known as lottery scheduling.
According to the fragment, what is the first step the OS takes when it wishes to start a program running under the limited direct execution technique?
The first step is that the OS creates a process entry for it in a process list.
In the limited direct execution technique, what does the OS do after loading the program code into memory?

After loading the program code into memory, the OS locates its entry point (i.e., the main() routine or something similar), then jumps to that entry point to execute the program, specifically executing the call to main() and running main().
According to the text, why can no ambiguity arise in prefix notation, and what is a second advantage of this notation?

No ambiguity can arise in prefix notation because the operator is always the leftmost element and the entire combination is delimited by the parentheses. A second advantage of prefix notation is that it extends in a straightforward way to allow combinations to be nested, that is, to have combinations whose elements are themselves combinations.
What is the status of the memo specified in RFC 1864?

This document specifies an Internet standards track protocol for the Internet community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements. Please refer to the current edition of the 'Internet Official Protocol Standards' (STD 1) for the standardization state and status of this protocol.
What does RFC 1864 specify regarding the Content-MD5 header field?
This memo specifies an optional header field, Content-MD5, for use with MIME-conformant messages.
What is the major challenge highlighted when building a distributed system, according to the text?
The major one we focus on is failure; machines, disks, networks, and software all fail from time to time, as we do not (and likely, will never) know how to build 'perfect' components and systems.
What is the desired appearance of a modern web service to its clients, and what is the basic question posed to achieve this?

When we build a modern web service, we’d like it to appear to clients as if it never fails. The basic question is: 'How can we build a working system out of parts that don’t work correctly all the time?'
愤怒的香蕉发表长文声明永久退出微博的原因是什么？他在文中是否道歉？
在网剧制作方的要求之下，愤怒的香蕉发表长文声明永久退出微博，但在文中仍坚持自己观点，不向任何人道歉。
根据《新京报》相关报道，愤怒的香蕉在写作时是否考虑女读者？网剧《赘婿》面对的观众群体有何特点？
《新京报》相关报道指“愤怒的香蕉坦言”在写作时并不考虑女读者，也许无可厚非。同时，“网络小说《赘婿》可以不需要女性读者，也不考虑女性感受，但改编成电视剧后，它所面对的就是一个更为广大、且主要由女性组成的观众群体。”
What is the role of the eval and apply procedures in the evaluation cycle described in Chapter 4?
The evaluation cycle will be embodied by the interplay between the two critical procedures in the evaluator, eval and apply, which are described in 4.1.1.
What does the implementation of the evaluator depend upon, and how is data abstraction used in this context?

The implementation of the evaluator will depend upon procedures that define the syntax of the expressions to be evaluated. We will use data abstraction to make the evaluator independent of the representation.
According to the preface, what does understanding how a journaling file system writes a block to disk represent?
According to the preface, if you comprehend what takes place when a journaling file system writes a block to disk, you have taken the first steps towards mastery of storage systems.
What is the difference between asides and tips as described in the preface?
Asides tend to discuss something relevant (but perhaps not essential) to the main text; tips tend to be general lessons that can be applied to systems you build.
What does the DIN standard DIN 91379 define for electronic processing of names and data exchange in Europe?

The DIN standard DIN 91379 defines a normative subset of Unicode Latin characters, sequences of base characters and diacritic signs, and special characters for use in names of persons, legal entities, products, addresses etc.
According to the fragment, which languages and scripts does the subset support?
The subset supports all official languages of European Union countries as well as the official languages of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland, and also the German minority lan.
What was the main issue with the old UNIX file system that led to poor performance?

The main issue was that the old UNIX file system treated the disk like it was a random-access memory; data was [the fragment is cut off, but the original text states: 'data was treated as if it were in memory, leading to terrible performance, with the file system delivering only 2% of overall disk bandwidth.']
According to the fragment, what did the abstractions of the file system aim to deliver?

The abstractions the file system was trying to deliver were files and the directory hierarchy. This easy-to-use system was a real step forward from the clumsy, record-based storage systems of the past, and the directory hierarchy was a true advance over simpler, one-level hierarchies provided by earlier systems.
研揚科技股份有限公司成立於哪一年？它在2011年成為了哪家公司的子公司？
研揚科技股份有限公司成立於1986年，2011年成為華碩電腦旗下子公司。
研揚科技在1992年和2004年分別投入了什麼領域或推出了什麼產品？
1992年，研揚科技針對生活自動化的領域，建立自行研發的能量，投入單板電腦市場；2004年，新加坡子公司成立，同時期推出「無風扇嵌入式工業電腦」。
What makes protection an important issue when allowing multiple programs to reside concurrently in memory?
Allowing multiple programs to reside concurrently in memory makes protection an important issue; you don’t want a process to be able to read, or worse, write some other process’s memory.
What abstraction does the OS create to keep users in mind, and what is it called?
The OS creates an easy to use abstraction of physical memory to keep those pesky users in mind. We call this abstraction the address space.
According to the instructor, what is the purpose of moving the small aside on VMMs into the appendix?
By moving this small aside on VMMs into the appendix, a particular instructor can choose whether to include it or skip it.
What reason does the instructor give for believing that the aside on VMMs should be included?
But I do think it should be included, because if you can understand how VMMs work, then you really understand virtualization quite well.
What happens in a virtual memory manager when a page fault occurs and there is a lot of free memory?
A page fault occurs, you find a free page on the free-page list, and assign it to the faulting page.
What does memory pressure force the operating system to do when little memory is free, and what is the role of the replacement policy?

In such a case, this memory pressure forces the OS to start paging out pages to make room for actively-used pages. Deciding which page (or pages) to evict is encapsulated within the replacement policy of the OS; historically, it was one of the most important decisions the early virtual memory systems made, as older systems had little physical memory.
Yum（Yellow dog Updater, Modified）是由哪个团队的修改开发而成的？它基于哪个软件包管理器？
Yum（Yellow dog Updater, Modified）是由Duke University團隊修改Yellow Dog Linux的Yellow Dog Updater開發而成，是一个基于RPM套件管理員的软件包管理器。
根据片段，Yum的图形化前端Yumex和kyum与Yum的关系是什么？使用它们时需要什么前提？
Yum的图形化前端主要有Yumex和kyum（KDE）。它们并不是独立于Yum的，而是Yum的图形前端，也就是说在安装和使用Yumex和kyum同时，都是以Yum为基础；所以在用Yumex或kyum时，必须先安装配置Yum。
According to the fragment, what is the title of the chapter and what is its main focus?

The title of the chapter is 'Vm Freespace', and its main focus is on free-space management. Specifically, the fragment states: 'In this chapter, we take a small detour from our discussion of virtual- izing memory to discuss a fundamental aspect of any memory manage- ment system, whether it be a malloc library (managing pages of a pro- cess’s heap) or the OS itself (managing portions of the address space of a process). Speciﬁcally, we will discuss the issues surrounding free-space management.'
Under what condition does the fragment state that managing free space can be easy, and how is it done in that case?

The fragment states that managing free space 'can certainly be easy' when 'the space you are managing is divided into ﬁxed-sized units'. In such a case, 'you just keep a list of these ﬁxed-sized units; when a client requests one o' (the text is cut off, but the key point is that you keep a list of the fixed-sized units to manage them).
宇瞻科技在哪一年獲得Intel PMO驗證，成為通路策略合作夥伴？
依據片段，宇瞻科技是「年亞洲第一家DRAM廠獲Intel PMO驗證，成為通路策略合作夥伴」，其中「年」為年份欄位缺漏，但根據後續2007年拓展印度市場的記載，此事件應發生於2007年之前；片段中未明確標示該年份，因此無法從片段中確定具體年份。
宇瞻科技在2015年與哪家公司共同宣佈透過何種方式進行策略性合作？
依據片段，「2015年與群聯電子共同宣佈透過私募方式進行策略性合作」，因此宇瞻科技在2015年與群聯電子共同宣佈透過私募方式進行策略性合作。
What makes Steel Empire notable among shoot 'em ups, and what is its setting?

Steel Empire is notable among shoot 'em ups for its unique aesthetic designs. Mostly low-tech in nature, with it being set in a late-19th century alternate world, the game's aircraft, weaponry, power-ups, environments, enemies and bosses are heavily stylized adding strong steampunk elements to the style, themes and visuals of the game.
According to the abstract of RFC 2136, what was the original design purpose of the Domain Name System?
According to the abstract of RFC 2136, the Domain Name System was originally designed to support queries of a statically configured database.
任天堂光盘通常包括哪几种类型？
通常包括任天堂GameCube游戏光碟、任天堂Wii光盘和任天堂Wii U光盘。
任天堂GameCube游戏光碟的容量是多少，以及它是基于什么技术开发的？
GameCube游戏光碟的容量为1.5 GB，使用MiniDVD的技术基础，以（CAV）的方式读取。
According to the figure described in the fragment, what is the total free space available, and how is it fragmented?
The total free space available is 20 bytes; unfortunately, it is fragmented into two chunks of size 10 each.
What is the problem addressed in the chapter, as illustrated by the example in the fragment?
A request for 15 bytes will fail even though there are 20 bytes free, and thus we arrive at the problem addressed in this chapter.
According to the fragment, what is the operating system sometimes referred to as, and why?

The operating system is sometimes referred to as a virtual machine because it takes a physical resource (such as memory, or a disk) and transforms it into a more general, powerful, and easy-to-use virtual form of itself.
What interfaces does the OS provide to allow users to tell it what to do, and how many system calls does a typical OS export?
The OS provides some interfaces (APIs) that you can call. A typical OS exports a few hundred system calls that are available to applications.
What is the role of policies in an operating system according to the text?

Policies are algorithms for making some kind of decision within the OS. For example, given a number of possible programs to run on a CPU, which program should the OS run? A scheduling policy in the OS will make this decision.
What information does a scheduling policy in the OS likely use to make its decision?

A scheduling policy likely uses historical information (e.g., which program has run more over the last minute?), workload knowledge (e.g., what types of programs are run), and performance metrics (e.g., is the system optimizing for interactive performance, or throughput?) to make its decision.
《榮譽勳章：鐵血悍將》是由哪個工作室開發的，遊戲劇情承接了哪一款遊戲？
《榮譽勳章：鐵血悍將》是美商藝電旗下的洛杉磯工作室Danger Close所開發的一款第一人稱射擊遊戲，遊戲劇情承接上一代《榮譽勳章2010》。
在《榮譽勳章：鐵血悍將》中，遊戲採用了哪一款引擎進行開發，多人連線模式由哪個團隊負責？
這次遊戲將完全採用戰地風雲系列製作團隊DICE所開發的最新一代物理破壞引擎Frostbite 2.0來進行遊戲開發，而多人連線模式也改為由Danger Close自行開發與設計。
What water resistance rating does the Moto G (3rd generation) have, and what does this allow the phone to do?

The Moto G 3rd-generation is water resistant through the use of nano-coating and internal rubber gaskets, giving it an IPX7 rating. This water resistance gives the phone the ability to be submerged in up to one meter (or about three feet) of water for 30 minutes at a time with the back cover secured correctly.
According to the fragment, what is the focus of the chapter on 'File Integrity' in relation to the file systems studied earlier?

In this chapter, we focus on reliability once again (having previously studied storage system reliability in the RAID chapter). Specifically, how should a file system or storage system ensure that data is safe, given the unreliable nature of modern storage devices? Thus, we will now investigate techniques used to ensure that the data you put into your storage system is the same when the storage system returns it to you.
What is the computational complexity of computing the relaxed intersection of intervals when the intervals are given, and which algorithm is used?
If the intervals are intervals, the relaxed intersection can be computed with a complexity of m.log(m) by using the Marzullo's algorithm.
What is the advantage of viewing a system in terms of current balance rather than by remembering the entire history of account transactions?
The advantage is that the system is viewed in terms of current balance rather than by remembering the entire history of account transactions.
According to the fragment, when is the view that a system is composed of separate objects most useful?

The view that a system is composed of separate objects is most useful when the state variables of the system can be grouped into closely coupled subsystems that are only loosely coupled to other subsystems.
What was one way to implement time sharing, as described in the fragment, and what was its major drawback?

One way to implement time sharing was to run one process for a short while, giving it full access to all memory, then stop it, save all of its state to some kind of disk (including all of physical memory), load some other process’s state, run it for a while, and thus implement some kind of crude sharing of the machine. Unfortunately, this approach has a big problem: it is way too slow, particularly as memory grows.
According to the fragment, why did interactivity become important in the context of time sharing?
Interactivity became important because many users might be concurrently using a machine, each waiting for (or hoping for) a timely response from their currently-executing tasks.
停火的定义是什么？发起停火的主体可以是哪些？
停火（又稱停戰）是指處於武力衝突的各方同意暫時停止交戰的行為，發起停火的國家或組織可以是介入衝突的某一方，或者是與衝突無直接關係的第三方介入協調。
除了暂停交战，停火还可能用于哪些其他场合？
停火也可能使用於其他場合：進行人道援助。包括撤退交戰地區的平民，運送糧食與醫療物資等。交換戰俘。包括送回一般或者是需要醫療的戰俘等，或者是對作戰地區的屍體進行清理的工作。進行戰場重整。包括對於戰線的整理，人員與武器的補給，防禦或者是進攻行動的規劃等。
根据资料，J语言是一种什么类型的编程语言？它由谁在何时发明？
根据资料，J语言是一种阵列编程语言，由肯尼斯·艾佛森和於1990年代初發明。
J语言的运算符运算规则是什么？请以2 * 3 + 4为例说明。
J语言的运算符，承袭APL传统，没有优先级并且最右先行，2 * 3 + 4按照2 * (3 + 4)来运算。
在影视作品的语境中，“領便當”一词的通常含义是什么？
領便當（或稱拎飯盒、领盒饭），用以借指故事中，一個角色因為死亡、失蹤或其他原因而下場。
根据资料，“领便当”的现代语源一般被认为是来自哪部作品中的哪个情节？

“领便当”的现代语源一般认为是来自于周星驰主演的《喜劇之王》中的一个情节，周星驰扮演的尹天仇在演出完一个很快死去的龙套角色后，他宣稱「臨時演員都是演員」，因為之前拍攝時自己裝死裝得不夠好，要求重拍，不願離開，導演則批評他的要求是浪費團隊的製作時間，催促他快點从剧务领饭盒（即“便当”）後離開，他惟有領取一個飯盒作為演出的酬劳并受到剧务奚落，此後「領飯盒」在香港便帶有死亡或被革走之意，再傳到中國大陸及台灣成為“领便当”。
根据资料片段，主键（primary key）和唯一键（unique key）有哪些区别？
根据片段，区别有：作为primary key的域／域组不能为Null，而unique key可以；一个表只能有一个primary key，但可有多个unique key；更大的区别在逻辑设计，primary key一般在逻辑设计中用作记录标识，这也是设置primary key的本意，而unique key只是为了保证域／域组的唯一性。
候选键（候选码）需要同时满足哪两个条件？为什么每个关系都至少有一个候选键？

According to the dialogue, what is the purpose of the advanced address translation structures mentioned, such as multi-level tables?
All to save a little space in memory!
What type of startups does Night Media focus on, and what do these startups gain access to?
Night Media focuses on "consumer-facing startups" which can then have access to the talent within Night Media.
Who leads the in-house studio created by Night Media in 2022, and what was his previous role?
The in-house studio created by Night Media in 2022 will be led by Alex Piper, the former Head of Unscripted Originals at YouTube.
What does the 'Lab Projects Systems' project primarily explore, and what system calls or concepts does it teach students about?

This project explores how a chunk of memory is managed, by building an alternative memory-allocation library (like malloc() and free() but with different names). The project teaches students how to use mmap() to get a chunk of anonymous memory, and then about pointers in great detail in order to build a simple (or perhaps, more complex) free list to manage the space.
In the 'Intro to Concurrency' project, what kind of libraries are built and what is the purpose of adding locks to real-world code?

Build some simple thread-safe libraries: a list, hash table, and some more complicated data structures are good exercises in adding locks to real-world code. The purpose is to introduce concurrent programming with POSIX threads.
m4 宏处理器在设计上具有哪些主要特点？
m4 的主要特点包括：式自由，而不是基于行的语法；高度的宏扩展（宏参数在扫描和插值中都会被扩展）；文本替换；参数替换；文件包含；字符串操作；条件判断；数算运算；系统接口；程序员诊断；独立于计算机编程语言；独立于自然语言；可编程。
m4 最初是为支持哪种方言而开发的，并且它具有什么重要的计算特性？
m4 最初是为支持Fortran的方言Ratfor而开发的。此外，m4还是一种图灵完备的编程语言。
What is the key observation regarding data security when an opponent cannot understand the data in the form it is obtained?

The key observation is that if an opponent cannot understand the data in the form it is obtained, our secrets are safe. Further, if the attacker cannot understand it, it probably can’t be altered, at least not in a controllable way.
What is the core technology used to convert data from one form to another in controlled ways with expected outcomes, as described in the text?
The core technology we’ll use is cryptography, a set of techniques to convert data from one form to another, in controlled ways with expected outcomes.
What is the purpose of including redundant text from already transmitted packets in the RTP payload format described in RFC 4351?
This RTP payload description recommends a method to include redundant text from already transmitted packets in order to reduce the risk of text loss caused by packet loss.
According to RFC 4351, what does the payload format for transmission of audio/t140c data cover?
The payload format for transmission of audio/t140c data is covered in Section 3.2, titled 'Payload Format for Transmission of audio/t140c Data'.
根据资料片段，SMACS J0723.3–7327 位于哪个星座，距离地球多远，以及它的天体坐标是什么？
根据资料片段，SMACS J0723.3–7327 是在南天星座飛魚座內，距離地球40億光年的一個星系團，其坐标为（RA/Dec = 110.8375, −73.4391667）。
根据资料片段，詹姆斯·韋伯太空望遠鏡（JWST）拍摄的SMACS J0723.3–7327的第一张全彩影像使用了什么仪器，并且影像中显示的红移物体表明它们有多少年历史？
根据资料片段，詹姆斯·韋伯太空望遠鏡（JWST）拍摄的SMACS J0723.3–7327的第一张全彩影像使用NIR相機（NIRCam）成像，包括譜密度，顯示了被該星團透鏡化的物體，紅移意味著它們有131億年的歷史。
According to the fragment, what must a virtual machine monitor (VMM) do when switching between two running virtual machines on a single processor?

In a manner quite similar to an operating system switching between running processes (a context switch), a virtual machine monitor must perform a machine switch between running virtual machines. Thus, when performing such a switch, the VMM must save the entire machine state of one OS (including registers, PC, and other state).
In the context of booting a new OS on top of the VMM, what action is described as 'as simple as that (well, almost)'?
When we wish to 'boot' a new OS on top of the VMM, we simply jump to the address of the first instruction and let the OS begin running. It is as simple as that (well, almost).
库普曼斯定理是如何将第一电离能与轨道能量关联的？该定理是在什么条件下提出的？
库普曼斯定理表明，在闭壳层的哈特里－福克近似下，一个体系的第一电离能等于其最高占据轨道（HOMO）的能量的负值。这个定理是1934年佳林·库普曼斯提出的。
根据片段，在密度泛函理论中，关于轨道能与电离能/亲和能的类似结论有何特点？其主要误差来源是什么？

在密度泛函理论中有着将第一电离能与电子亲和能分别与HOMO/LUMO的单电子轨道能关联起来的类似结论，尽管其推导过程与确切表述都与原始的库普曼斯定理有差异。通常，从密度泛函理论轨道能计算得到的单电子轨道能误差较大，可远大于2电子伏特，并与交换相关势的形式相关。在通常的近似下，DFT方法得到的LUMO轨道能与电子亲和能的相关性并不好。在密度泛函理论的库普曼斯定理中，误差的主要来源是交换相关能量泛函的不准确性。
According to the table of contents, what is the title of section 5.5 and on which page does it appear?
The title of section 5.5 is "Process Control And Users" and it appears on page 48.
What is the title of chapter 6 and what is the page number for its basic technique subsection?
The title of chapter 6 is "Mechanism: Limited Direct Execution" and the basic technique subsection, titled "Basic Technique: Limited Direct Execution", is on page 57.
According to the fragment, what happens when multiple calling threads call into sem_wait()?
Multiple calling threads may call into sem_wait(), and thus all be queued waiting to be woken.
What invariant about the value of a semaphore is mentioned in the fragment?
The value of the semaphore, when negative, is equal to the number of waiting threads.
In Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing, what do players start in and what do they have to race their way up to in Career mode?
In Career mode, players start in the All-Star TQ Midgets and have to race their way up to the 410 Winged Sprint Cars in the All Star Circuit of Champions.
Intel 4004处理器是在何时发布的？它被描述为什么？
Intel 4004是美國英特爾公司 (Intel) 推出的第1款商用微處理器，也是全球第一款商用微處理器；1971年11月15日发布。
Intel 4004的名字中，第一个“4”和后面的“4”分别代表什么含义？
第一位4表示它是一个4位CPU（4bit），后面的4是序号，因为用4004组装的计算机是由4001（ROM）+4002（RAM）+4003（移位寄存器）+4004（CPU）+4008（地址锁存器）+4009（IO接口）组成。
According to the fragment, what are the two main components that must be designed when designing a register machine?
To design a register machine, we must design its data paths (registers and operations) and the controller that sequences these operations.

Euclid’s Algorithm is used to illustrate the design of a simple register machine, and it is used to compute the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two integers.

根据资料片段，贝姆垃圾收集器（BoehmGC）的外部链接中包含了哪些开发相关的资源或文章？

外部链接包括：Git repo for BoehmGC development、Transparent Programmer-Directed Garbage Collection for C++（作者 Hans-J. Boehm 和 Michael Spertus）、Using the C/C++ Garbage Collection Library（来自 Dr. Dobbs）、The Boehm Collector for C and C++（作者 Gene Michael Stover，日期 March 01, 2003）。
根据资料片段，.invalid域名是由哪个组织在哪个文件中规定的？
根据资料片段，.invalid域名是由互联网工程任务组（IETF）在RFC 2606（1999年6月）文件中规定在互联网域名系统（DNS）中所被保留的不被安装为顶级域的域名标签。
资料片段中提到，.invalid顶级域名在会话发起协议中有怎样的用途？
资料片段中提到，在会话发起协议有一个显著的例子，其使用了 anonymous.invalid 来指示隐藏的来电者的身份。
What is the core premise of the thought experiment known as Roko's basilisk?

The thought experiment states that an otherwise benevolent artificial superintelligence (AI) in the future would be incentivized to create a virtual reality simulation to torture anyone who knew of its potential existence but did not directly contribute to its advancement or development, in order to incentivise said advancement.
Where did Roko's basilisk originate, and what is the basis of its name?

It originated in a 2010 post at discussion board LessWrong, a technical forum focused on analytical rational enquiry. The thought experiment's name derives from the poster of the article (Roko) and the basilisk, a mythical creature capable of destroying enemies with its stare.
遠東地區的驅逐者為何比其他地區的驅逐者實力更勝一籌？
遠東地區有著相比他處更多成群的巨大化吃人昆蟲，在艱苦成長的環境中，該地區的驅逐者有著相比其他地區更勝一籌的實力。
Where and when was the Andrew File System (AFS) introduced?
The Andrew File System (AFS) was introduced at Carnegie-Mellon University (CMU) in the 1980’s.
What was the main goal of the Andrew File System project, and who led it?

The main goal of the Andrew File System project was scale, specifically how to design a distributed file system such that a server can support as many clients as possible. The project was led by the well-known Professor M. Satya-narayanan of Carnegie-Mellon University, referred to as 'Satya' for short.
《一點都不想相親的我設下高門檻條件，結果同班同學成了婚約對象！？》這部輕小說系列的作者是誰？它最初於何時在何網站上開始連載？
《一點都不想相親的我設下高門檻條件，結果同班同學成了婚約對象！？》是櫻木櫻創作的日本輕小說系列，2020年5月26日起於小說投稿網站成為小說家吧上連載。
